  <script type="text/babel">
    const {useState,useEffect,useRef} = React;



// API key is entered in the app UI — no code editing needed

const TIFFANY = "#81D8D0";

const TORII_IMG = "data:image/png;base64,";

function ToriiSVG({ size = 96, className = "", style = {} }) {
  return (
    <img
      src={TORII_IMG}
      width={size * 1.4}
      height={size}
      className={className}
      style={{
        display: "block",
        filter: "drop-shadow(0 0 12px #81D8D0) drop-shadow(0 0 28px #81D8D080)",
        ...style,
      }}
      alt="torii"
    />
  );
}

// ─── KAMI ARRIVAL SOUNDS ─────────────────────────────────────
const KAMI_SOUND_MAP = {
  // 天照系 — 明るく澄んだ鐘、光の波
  "天照大御神": "amaterasu",
  "天宇受売命": "amaterasu",
  "豊受比売神": "amaterasu",
  "天之常立神": "amaterasu",
  // スサノオ系 — 嵐、低い轟き
  "素戔嗚尊":   "susanoo",
  "須佐之男命": "susanoo",
  "建御雷神":   "thunder",
  "経津主神":   "thunder",
  "建御名方神": "thunder",
  // 月読系 — 静寂、銀の鈴
  "月読命":     "tsukuyomi",
  "瀬織津姫":   "tsukuyomi",
  "罔象女神":   "tsukuyomi",
  // 大国主系 — 温かい弦、縁の音
  "大国主命":   "okuninushi",
  "事代主神":   "okuninushi",
  "少名毘古那神":"okuninushi",
  // 黄泉系 — 深い闇、不気味な響き
  "伊弉冉尊":   "yomi",
  "伊弉諾尊":   "yomi",
  "軻遇突智神": "yomi",
  // 稲荷系 — 軽い狐火、神秘的
  "稲荷大神":   "inari",
  "大山祇神":   "inari",
};

function playKamiSound(kamiName, rarity) {
  try {
    const ctx = getAudioCtx();
    if (ctx.state === "suspended") ctx.resume();
    const soundType = KAMI_SOUND_MAP[kamiName] || "default";
    const now = ctx.currentTime;
    const vol = rarity === "ultra" ? 0.8 : rarity === "rare" ? 0.7 : 0.6;

    const master = ctx.createGain();
    master.gain.value = vol;
    master.connect(ctx.destination);

    const rev = ctx.createDelay(0.4); rev.delayTime.value = 0.35;
    const revG = ctx.createGain(); revG.gain.value = 0.45;
    rev.connect(revG); revG.connect(master);
    const send = (n) => { n.connect(master); n.connect(rev); };

    if (soundType === "amaterasu") {
      // 明るく高い鐘が7層で上昇
      [[528,0.5,0],[660,0.35,0.08],[792,0.25,0.14],[1056,0.2,0.05],[1320,0.15,0.12],[1760,0.1,0.19],[2640,0.07,0.25]].forEach(([f,v,d]) => {
        const o = ctx.createOscillator(), e = ctx.createGain();
        o.type = "sine"; o.frequency.value = f;
        o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(f*0.996, now+d+0.2);
        e.gain.setValueAtTime(0, now+d); e.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v, now+d+0.004);
        e.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now+d+3.5);
        o.connect(e); send(e); o.start(now+d); o.stop(now+d+3.6);
      });
      // 光のグレースノート
      const g = ctx.createOscillator(), ge = ctx.createGain();
      g.type = "sine"; g.frequency.setValueAtTime(1760, now+0.4);
      g.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(2640, now+0.8);
      ge.gain.setValueAtTime(0, now+0.4); ge.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.08, now+0.5);
      ge.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now+1.8);
      g.connect(ge); send(ge); g.start(now+0.4); g.stop(now+1.9);

    } else if (soundType === "susanoo") {
      // 低い嵐の轟き + 風の唸り
      [40,55,80,110].forEach((f,i) => {
        const o = ctx.createOscillator(), e = ctx.createGain();
        o.type = i < 2 ? "sine" : "sawtooth";
        o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f*1.3, now+i*0.04);
        o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(f, now+i*0.04+0.8);
        const lp = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); lp.type = "lowpass"; lp.frequency.value = 300+i*50;
        e.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3-i*0.05, now+i*0.04);
        e.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now+i*0.04+3);
        o.connect(lp); lp.connect(e); send(e); o.start(now+i*0.04); o.stop(now+i*0.04+3.1);
      });
      // 嵐の風ノイズ
      const b = ctx.createBuffer(1, ctx.sampleRate*1.2, ctx.sampleRate);
      const d = b.getChannelData(0);
      for(let i=0;i<d.length;i++) d[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*0.04;
      const ns = ctx.createBufferSource(); ns.buffer = b;
      const bp = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); bp.type = "bandpass"; bp.frequency.value = 400; bp.Q.value = 0.5;
      const ng = ctx.createGain();
      ng.gain.setValueAtTime(0.5, now); ng.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now+1.2);
      ns.connect(bp); bp.connect(ng); send(ng); ns.start(now);
      // 決定的な高音
      [440,660,880].forEach((f,i) => {
        const o = ctx.createOscillator(), e = ctx.createGain();
        o.type = "sine"; o.frequency.value = f;
        e.gain.setValueAtTime(0, now+0.6+i*0.08); e.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.18-i*0.04, now+0.62+i*0.08);
        e.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now+0.62+i*0.08+1.5);
        o.connect(e); send(e); o.start(now+0.6+i*0.08); o.stop(now+0.62+i*0.08+1.6);
      });

    } else if (soundType === "tsukuyomi") {
      // 静寂の中の銀の鈴 — 高く繊細
      [1760,2093,2637,3136,4186].forEach((f,i) => {
        const o = ctx.createOscillator(), e = ctx.createGain();
        o.type = "sine"; o.frequency.value = f;
        e.gain.setValueAtTime(0, now+i*0.18); e.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.14-i*0.02, now+i*0.18+0.003);
        e.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now+i*0.18+2.5);
        o.connect(e); send(e); o.start(now+i*0.18); o.stop(now+i*0.18+2.6);
      });
      // 深い静寂の低音持続
      const o2 = ctx.createOscillator(), e2 = ctx.createGain();
      o2.type = "sine"; o2.frequency.value = 110;
      e2.gain.setValueAtTime(0, now); e2.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.12, now+0.5);
      e2.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now+4);
      o2.connect(e2); send(e2); o2.start(now); o2.stop(now+4.1);

    } else if (soundType === "okuninushi") {
      // 縁の弦 — 琴風、温かい
      [[261.6,0],[329.6,0.12],[392,0.22],[523.2,0.08],[659.3,0.18],[784,0.28]].forEach(([f,d]) => {
        const o = ctx.createOscillator(), e = ctx.createGain();
        o.type = "sine"; o.frequency.value = f;
        e.gain.setValueAtTime(0, now+d); e.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.2, now+d+0.006);
        e.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now+d+2.5);
        o.connect(e); send(e); o.start(now+d); o.stop(now+d+2.6);
      });

    } else if (soundType === "yomi") {
      // 黄泉の深淵 — 低いドローン + 不気味な上昇
      [27.5,41.2,55].forEach((f,i) => {
        const o = ctx.createOscillator(), e = ctx.createGain();
        o.type = "sine"; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f*0.5, now+i*0.05);
        o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(f, now+i*0.05+1.5);
        const lp = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); lp.type = "lowpass"; lp.frequency.value = 180;
        e.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, now+i*0.05); e.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now+4);
        o.connect(lp); lp.connect(e); send(e); o.start(now+i*0.05); o.stop(now+4.1);
      });
      const sw = ctx.createOscillator(), se = ctx.createGain();
      sw.type = "sine"; sw.frequency.setValueAtTime(80, now+0.5);
      sw.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(1320, now+2.5);
      se.gain.setValueAtTime(0, now+0.5); se.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.15, now+0.8);
      se.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now+3);
      sw.connect(se); send(se); sw.start(now+0.5); sw.stop(now+3.1);

    } else if (soundType === "inari") {
      // 稲荷の狐火 — 軽い不規則な閃光
      [880,1320,1760,2200,1100,2640,1760].forEach((f,i) => {
        const o = ctx.createOscillator(), e = ctx.createGain();
        o.type = "sine"; o.frequency.value = f;
        e.gain.setValueAtTime(0, now+i*0.08); e.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.12, now+i*0.08+0.005);
        e.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now+i*0.08+0.5);
        o.connect(e); send(e); o.start(now+i*0.08); o.stop(now+i*0.08+0.51);
      });
      [[440,0.6],[660,0.65],[880,0.7]].forEach(([f,t]) => {
        const o = ctx.createOscillator(), e = ctx.createGain();
        o.type = "triangle"; o.frequency.value = f;
        e.gain.setValueAtTime(0, now+t); e.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.1, now+t+0.15);
        e.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now+t+2.5);
        o.connect(e); send(e); o.start(now+t); o.stop(now+t+2.6);
      });

    } else if (soundType === "thunder") {
      // 雷神 — 雷鳴の衝撃
      const b2 = ctx.createBuffer(1, ctx.sampleRate*0.2, ctx.sampleRate);
      const d2 = b2.getChannelData(0);
      for(let i=0;i<d2.length;i++) d2[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*Math.exp(-i/(ctx.sampleRate*0.04));
      const ns2 = ctx.createBufferSource(); ns2.buffer = b2;
      const lp2 = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); lp2.type="lowpass"; lp2.frequency.value=200;
      const ng2 = ctx.createGain(); ng2.gain.value=0.8;
      ns2.connect(lp2); lp2.connect(ng2); send(ng2); ns2.start(now);
      [40,60,80].forEach((f,i) => {
        const o = ctx.createOscillator(), e = ctx.createGain();
        o.type = "sine"; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f*2, now+i*0.02);
        o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(f, now+i*0.02+0.3);
        e.gain.setValueAtTime(0.4-i*0.08, now+i*0.02); e.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now+i*0.02+2.5);
        o.connect(e); send(e); o.start(now+i*0.02); o.stop(now+i*0.02+2.6);
      });
      [1320,1760,2640].forEach((f,i) => {
        const o = ctx.createOscillator(), e = ctx.createGain();
        o.type = "sine"; o.frequency.value = f;
        e.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15-i*0.03, now+0.4+i*0.06); e.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now+0.4+i*0.06+1.5);
        o.connect(e); send(e); o.start(now+0.4+i*0.06); o.stop(now+0.4+i*0.06+1.6);
      });

    } else {
      // default — 霊感の波（existing）
      playDivineSound("full");
      return;
    }
  } catch(err) { playDivineSound("full"); }
}
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// ─── ULTRA RARE SOUND ────────────────────────────────────────
function playUltraRareSound() {
  try {
    const ctx = getAudioCtx();
    if (ctx.state === "suspended") ctx.resume();
    const now = ctx.currentTime;
    const master = ctx.createGain();
    master.gain.setValueAtTime(0, now);
    master.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.6, now + 0.01);
    master.connect(ctx.destination);

    // Choir-like ascending chord
    [[264,0.3,0,4],[330,0.25,0.3,3.5],[396,0.2,0.6,3],[528,0.18,0.9,2.8],[660,0.15,1.2,2.5],[792,0.12,1.5,2.2]].forEach(([f,v,delay,dec]) => {
      const o = ctx.createOscillator(); const e = ctx.createGain();
      o.type = "sine"; o.frequency.value = f;
      e.gain.setValueAtTime(0, now+delay);
      e.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v, now+delay+0.08);
      e.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now+delay+dec);
      o.connect(e); e.connect(master);
      o.start(now+delay); o.stop(now+delay+dec+0.1);
    });
    // Sub bass boom
    const sub = ctx.createOscillator(); const se = ctx.createGain();
    sub.type = "sine"; sub.frequency.setValueAtTime(55, now);
    sub.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(40, now+1.5);
    se.gain.setValueAtTime(0.4, now); se.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now+2);
    sub.connect(se); se.connect(master); sub.start(now); sub.stop(now+2.1);
  } catch(e) {}
}
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// ─── DIVINE SOUND ENGINE ─────────────────────────────────────
let _audioCtx = null;
function getAudioCtx() {
  if (!_audioCtx || _audioCtx.state === "closed") {
    _audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
  }
  return _audioCtx;
}

function playDivineSound(variant = "full") {
  try {
    const ctx = getAudioCtx();
    if (ctx.state === "suspended") ctx.resume();
    const now = ctx.currentTime;

    // ── Reverb network ──
    const master = ctx.createGain();
    master.gain.setValueAtTime(0, now);
    master.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(variant === "full" ? 0.72 : 0.5, now + 0.01);
    master.connect(ctx.destination);

    const d1 = ctx.createDelay(1); d1.delayTime.value = 0.3;
    const d2 = ctx.createDelay(1); d2.delayTime.value = 0.5;
    const f1 = ctx.createGain(); f1.gain.value = 0.28;
    const f2 = ctx.createGain(); f2.gain.value = 0.2;
    const lp = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); lp.type = "lowpass"; lp.frequency.value = 3800;
    const wg = ctx.createGain(); wg.gain.value = 0.5;
    d1.connect(f1); f1.connect(d1); d1.connect(lp);
    d2.connect(f2); f2.connect(d2); d2.connect(lp);
    lp.connect(wg); wg.connect(master);
    const send = (n) => { n.connect(master); n.connect(d1); n.connect(d2); };

    // ── 霊感の波 — 18音コーラスパッドがゆっくり展開 ──
    const freqs = [396, 528, 594, 660, 792, 990];
    freqs.forEach((f, i) => {
      [-0.5, 0, 0.5].forEach((detune, j) => {
        const o = ctx.createOscillator(), e = ctx.createGain();
        o.type = "sine"; o.frequency.value = f + detune;
        e.gain.setValueAtTime(0, now + i * 0.1 + j * 0.03);
        e.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.12 / freqs.length, now + i * 0.1 + j * 0.03 + 0.4);
        e.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + i * 0.1 + j * 0.03 + (variant === "full" ? 3.5 : 2.5));
        o.connect(e); send(e);
        o.start(now + i * 0.1 + j * 0.03);
        o.stop(now + i * 0.1 + j * 0.03 + (variant === "full" ? 3.6 : 2.6));
      });
    });

    if (variant === "full") {
      // Ascending shimmer cascade
      [1320, 1980, 2640, 3960].forEach((f, i) => {
        const o = ctx.createOscillator(), e = ctx.createGain();
        o.type = "sine"; o.frequency.value = f;
        e.gain.setValueAtTime(0, now + 0.6 + i * 0.15);
        e.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.07, now + 0.65 + i * 0.15);
        e.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.65 + i * 0.15 + 1.0);
        o.connect(e); send(e);
        o.start(now + 0.6 + i * 0.15);
        o.stop(now + 0.65 + i * 0.15 + 1.01);
      });
    }

    // Noise breath
    const bufSize = ctx.sampleRate * 0.07;
    const nb = ctx.createBuffer(1, bufSize, ctx.sampleRate);
    const nd = nb.getChannelData(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < bufSize; i++) nd[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.1;
    const ns = ctx.createBufferSource(); ns.buffer = nb;
    const hp = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); hp.type = "highpass"; hp.frequency.value = 4500;
    const ne = ctx.createGain();
    ne.gain.setValueAtTime(0.22, now);
    ne.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.07);
    ns.connect(hp); hp.connect(ne); send(ne);
    ns.start(now);
  } catch (e) {}
}
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// BGM — synthesized ambient (lightweight)
const BGM_B64 = null; // Use Web Audio synth below

function playBGMSynth(gainNode, ctx) {
  const rev = ctx.createDelay(1); rev.delayTime.value = 0.5;
  const revG = ctx.createGain(); revG.gain.value = 0.4;
  rev.connect(revG); revG.connect(gainNode);
  const send = (n) => { n.connect(gainNode); n.connect(rev); };
  const chords = [
    [130.8,164.8,196,261.6],[146.8,185,220,293.7],
    [110,138.6,165,220],[123.5,155.6,185,247],
  ];
  let ci = 0; let playing = true;
  const nodes = [];
  const playChord = () => {
    if (!playing) return;
    const chord = chords[ci++ % chords.length];
    const now = ctx.currentTime;
    chord.forEach((f,i) => {
      const o = ctx.createOscillator(), e = ctx.createGain();
      o.type="sine"; o.frequency.value=f;
      e.gain.setValueAtTime(0,now);
      e.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.06-i*0.01,now+1.5);
      e.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.03,now+5);
      e.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,now+8);
      o.connect(e); send(e); o.start(now); o.stop(now+8.5);
      nodes.push(o);
    });
    [523.2,659.3,784].forEach((f,i)=>{
      const o=ctx.createOscillator(),e=ctx.createGain();
      o.type="sine"; o.frequency.value=f;
      e.gain.setValueAtTime(0,now+2+i*0.3);
      e.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.018,now+2.4+i*0.3);
      e.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,now+7);
      o.connect(e); send(e); o.start(now+2+i*0.3); o.stop(now+8);
      nodes.push(o);
    });
    if (playing) setTimeout(playChord, 7000);
  };
  playChord();
  return () => { playing=false; nodes.forEach(n=>{try{n.stop();}catch(e){}}); };
}


const GUARDIAN_SVGS = {
  dragon: ({ col }) => (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 120 120" width="100%" height="100%" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
      <defs><filter id="gdf2"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3" result="b"/><feMerge><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge></filter></defs>
      <g filter="url(#gdf2)" stroke={col} fill="none" strokeLinecap="round">
        <path d="M20,80 C30,60 50,40 70,50 C90,60 100,80 90,95 C80,110 50,105 35,95 C25,88 18,86 20,80Z" strokeWidth="2.5" fill={col} opacity="0.15"/>
        <path d="M70,50 C75,35 85,20 95,15 C88,25 85,35 80,40" strokeWidth="2" opacity="0.8"/>
        <path d="M65,45 C55,25 60,10 70,5 C65,18 62,30 65,45" strokeWidth="2" opacity="0.7"/>
        <circle cx="88" cy="32" r="4" fill={col} opacity="0.9"/>
        <path d="M30,75 L20,95 M45,85 L38,105 M60,88 L58,108" strokeWidth="2" opacity="0.6"/>
        <path d="M20,80 C10,75 8,65 15,60" strokeWidth="2.5" opacity="0.8"/>
      </g>
    </svg>
  ),
  fox: ({ col }) => (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 120 120" width="100%" height="100%" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
      <defs><filter id="gdf3"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3" result="b"/><feMerge><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge></filter></defs>
      <g filter="url(#gdf3)" stroke={col} fill="none" strokeLinecap="round">
        <path d="M40,90 C40,70 50,55 60,50 C70,55 80,70 80,90Z" strokeWidth="2" fill={col} opacity="0.15"/>
        <path d="M60,50 C55,35 45,20 35,15 C45,22 55,35 60,50Z" strokeWidth="2" fill={col} opacity="0.2"/>
        <path d="M60,50 C65,35 75,20 85,15 C75,22 65,35 60,50Z" strokeWidth="2" fill={col} opacity="0.2"/>
        <ellipse cx="52" cy="58" rx="4" ry="5" strokeWidth="1.5" opacity="0.8"/>

  ),

      <defs><filter id="gdf4"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3" result="b"/><feMerge><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge></filter></defs>
      <g filter="url(#gdf4)" stroke={col} fill="none" strokeLinecap="round">
        <path d="M60,30 C50,50 20,60 15,75 C30,65 50,65 60,60 C70,65 90,65 105,75 C100,60 70,50 60,30Z" strokeWidth="2" fill={col} opacity="0.2"/>
        <circle cx="60" cy="25" r="12" strokeWidth="2" fill={col} opacity="0.1"/>

      <g filter="url(#gdf5)" stroke={col} fill="none" strokeLinecap="round">
        <path d="M60,20 C60,20 40,45 20,50 C35,52 50,48 60,55 C70,48 85,52 100,50 C80,45 60,20 60,20Z" strokeWidth="2" fill={col} opacity="0.2"/>
        <path d="M60,55 C55,70 50,85 45,100 C53,88 60,75 60,75 C60,75 67,88 75,100 C70,85 65,70 60,55Z" strokeWidth="2" fill={col} opacity="0.2"/>
        <path d="M15,48 C10,35 15,20 25,18 M105,48 C110,35 105,20 95,18" strokeWidth="2" opacity="0.7"/>
        <circle cx="60" cy="35" r="8" strokeWidth="2" opacity="0.8"/>
        <path d="M55,95 C50,108 55,115 60,112 C65,115 70,108 65,95" strokeWidth="2" opacity="0.6"/>

    </svg>
  ),
  tiger: ({ col }) => (

      <defs><filter id="gdf6"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3" result="b"/><feMerge><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge></filter></defs>
      <g filter="url(#gdf6)" stroke={col} fill="none" strokeLinecap="round">
        <ellipse cx="60" cy="65" rx="32" ry="28" strokeWidth="2" fill={col} opacity="0.1"/>
        <ellipse cx="60" cy="40" rx="20" ry="18" strokeWidth="2" fill={col} opacity="0.1"/>
        <ellipse cx="48" cy="28" rx="8" ry="10" strokeWidth="1.5" opacity="0.8"/>
        <ellipse cx="72" cy="28" rx="8" ry="10" strokeWidth="1.5" opacity="0.8"/>
        <ellipse cx="52" cy="42" rx="4" ry="5" strokeWidth="1.5" opacity="0.9"/>
        <ellipse cx="68" cy="42" rx="4" ry="5" strokeWidth="1.5" opacity="0.9"/>
        <path d="M55,52 C57,55 63,55 65,52" strokeWidth="2" opacity="0.7"/>
        <path d="M40,60 L15,55 M40,68 L15,70 M80,60 L105,55 M80,68 L105,70" strokeWidth="2" opacity="0.5"/>
        <path d="M50,88 L45,110 M60,90 L60,112 M70,88 L75,110" strokeWidth="2" opacity="0.6"/>

    </svg>
  ),
  turtle: ({ col }) => (

      <g filter="url(#gdf7)" stroke={col} fill="none" strokeLinecap="round">
        <ellipse cx="60" cy="65" rx="35" ry="28" strokeWidth="2.5" fill={col} opacity="0.12"/>
        <path d="M35,50 L45,38 L60,35 L75,38 L85,50 L88,65 L85,80 L75,88 L60,90 L45,88 L35,80 L32,65Z" strokeWidth="1.5" opacity="0.6"/>

    <svg viewBox="0 0 120 120" width="100%" height="100%" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
      <defs>
        <filter id="gdf"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3" result="b"/><feMerge><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge></filter>
      </defs>

        <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="35" strokeWidth="1.5" opacity="0.4"/>
        <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="25" strokeWidth="2" opacity="0.6"/>
        {[0,45,90,135,180,225,270,315].map((deg,i)=>{
          const rad=deg*Math.PI/180, r1=26, r2=38;
          return <line key={i} x1={60+r1*Math.cos(rad)} y1={60+r1*Math.sin(rad)} x2={60+r2*Math.cos(rad)} y2={60+r2*Math.sin(rad)} strokeWidth="2" opacity="0.5"/>;
        })}
        <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="10" fill={col} opacity="0.4" strokeWidth="2"/>

};

function getGuardianType(name) {
  if (!name) return "default";
  const n = name;
  if (/龍|竜|りゅう|りゅ/.test(n)) return "dragon";
  if (/狐|きつね|稲荷/.test(n)) return "fox";
  if (/烏|からす|鴉|八咫|金烏/.test(n)) return "crow";
  if (/鳳凰|朱雀|不死鳥|ほうおう|すざく/.test(n)) return "phoenix";
  if (/虎|とら|白虎/.test(n)) return "tiger";
  if (/亀|玄武|蛇|かめ|げんぶ/.test(n)) return "turtle";
  return "default";
}

function GuardianSection({ spirit, rarity }) {
  const RARITY_COLOR = { common: "#81D8D0", high: "#e8b830", rare: "#81D8D0", ultra: "#ff55ff" };
  const col = RARITY_COLOR[rarity] || "#81D8D0";
  return (
    <div style={{
      textAlign: "center", marginBottom: 28, padding: "24px 18px",
      border: "1px solid " + col + "44",
      borderRadius: 4,
      background: col + "06",
      animation: "revealText 0.7s 0.3s ease both",
    }}>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 10, letterSpacing: 5, color: "#2a5a58", marginBottom: 18 }}>— 守護霊獣 —</div>
      <GuardianSpiritIcon name={spirit} color={col} rarity={rarity} />
      <div style={{
        marginTop: 18, fontSize: 20,
        fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif",
        fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: 6, color: col,
      }}>
        {spirit}
      </div>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#4a6060", marginTop: 6, letterSpacing: 3 }}>タップで反応</div>
    </div>
  );
}

function GuardianSpiritIcon({ name, color, rarity }) {
  const [tapped, setTapped] = useState(false);
  const type = getGuardianType(name);
  const SvgComp = GUARDIAN_SVGS[type] || GUARDIAN_SVGS.default;

  const handleTap = () => {
    if (tapped) return;
    setTapped(true);
    try { playDivineSound("full"); } catch(e) {}
    setTimeout(() => setTapped(false), 700);
  };

  const glowNormal = {
    ultra: "0 0 30px rgba(255,85,255,0.8), 0 0 60px rgba(255,85,255,0.4)",
    rare:  "0 0 22px rgba(129,216,208,0.7)",
    high:  "0 0 16px rgba(200,169,110,0.6)",
    common:"0 0 10px rgba(129,216,208,0.4)",
  }[rarity] || "0 0 10px rgba(129,216,208,0.4)";

  return (
    <div
      onClick={handleTap}
      style={{
        position: "relative",
        width: 120, height: 120,
        margin: "0 auto",
        cursor: "pointer",
        WebkitTapHighlightColor: "transparent",
        userSelect: "none",
      }}
    >
      {/* Glow bg */}
      <div style={{
        position: "absolute", inset: -16, borderRadius: "50%",
        background: `radial-gradient(circle, ${color}${tapped?"28":"10"} 0%, transparent 70%)`,
        transition: "background 0.4s", pointerEvents: "none",
      }} />
      {/* Slow ring */}
      <div style={{
        position: "absolute", inset: -6, borderRadius: "50%",
        border: `1px solid ${color}${tapped?"80":"30"}`,
        animation: "spin-slow 14s linear infinite",
        transition: "border-color 0.3s", pointerEvents: "none",
      }} />
      {(rarity === "rare" || rarity === "ultra") && (
        <div style={{
          position: "absolute", inset: -2, borderRadius: "50%",
          border: `1px solid ${color}${tapped?"55":"18"}`,
          animation: "spin-slow 8s linear infinite reverse",
          transition: "border-color 0.3s", pointerEvents: "none",
        }} />
      )}
      {/* Ripple */}
      {tapped && (
        <div style={{
          position: "absolute", inset: -4, borderRadius: "50%",
          border: `2px solid ${color}`,
          animation: "ripple 0.7s ease-out forwards",
          pointerEvents: "none",
        }} />
      )}
      {/* SVG */}
      <div style={{
        width: "100%", height: "100%",
        filter: `drop-shadow(${tapped ? `0 0 50px ${color}, 0 0 100px ${color}80` : glowNormal})`,
        transform: tapped ? "scale(1.14) rotate(-3deg)" : "scale(1) rotate(0deg)",
        transition: "transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), filter 0.3s ease",
        pointerEvents: "none",
      }}>
        <SvgComp col={color} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// ── Selection Effect — divine burst ──────────────────────────
const TAP_KANJI = ["神","縁","命","霊","光","天","力","道","魂","聖","潔","福"];

function TapBurstEffect({ effects }) {
  return (
    <>
      {effects.map(({ id, x, y, color }) => {
        const rays16    = Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, i) => i * 45);
        const rays8fast = [];
        const sparks    = Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, i) => {
          const angle = (i / 14) * Math.PI * 2;
          const dist  = 55 + Math.random() * 70;
          return {
            sx: Math.cos(angle) * dist + "px",
            sy: Math.sin(angle) * dist + "px",
            size: 4 + Math.random() * 6,
            col: i % 3 === 0 ? "#fff5a0" : i % 3 === 1 ? color : "#ffffff",
            delay: Math.random() * 0.08,
          };
        });
        const kanji = TAP_KANJI[Math.floor(Math.random() * TAP_KANJI.length)];
        const gold  = "#ffd700";

        return (
          <div key={id} style={{ position: "fixed", left: x, top: y, zIndex: 300, pointerEvents: "none" }}>

            {/* ── Center flash bloom ── */}
            <div style={{
              position: "absolute",
              width: 120, height: 120, borderRadius: "50%",
              background: `radial-gradient(circle, ${color}90 0%, ${gold}40 40%, transparent 70%)`,
              marginLeft: -60, marginTop: -60,
              animation: "selectFlash 0.65s ease-out forwards",
              filter: `blur(2px)`,
            }} />

            {/* ── Outer ring ── */}
            <div style={{
              position: "absolute",
              width: 160, height: 160, borderRadius: "50%",
              border: `2px solid ${color}`,
              marginLeft: -80, marginTop: -80,
              animation: "selectRipple 0.9s ease-out forwards",
              boxShadow: `0 0 24px ${color}80, inset 0 0 24px ${color}30`,
            }} />

            {/* ── Second ripple (gold, delayed) ── */}
            <div style={{
              position: "absolute",
              width: 100, height: 100, borderRadius: "50%",
              border: `1.5px solid ${gold}`,
              marginLeft: -50, marginTop: -50,
              animation: "selectRipple 1.1s 0.08s ease-out forwards",
              boxShadow: `0 0 16px ${gold}60`,
            }} />

            {/* ── 16 long beams ── */}
            {rays16.map((deg, i) => (
              <div key={i} style={{
                position: "absolute",
                width: 2, height: 70,
                background: `linear-gradient(180deg, ${i%2===0?color:gold} 0%, transparent 100%)`,
                left: -1, top: -70,
                transformOrigin: "50% 100%",
                transform: `rotate(${deg}deg) translateY(-12px)`,
                animation: `selectBeam 0.6s ${i*0.02}s ease-out forwards`,
                "--r": `${deg}deg`,
                borderRadius: 2,
              }} />
            ))}

            {/* ── 8 short accent beams ── */}
            {rays8fast.map((deg, i) => (
              <div key={i} style={{
                position: "absolute",
                width: 3, height: 40,
                background: `linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, transparent 100%)`,
                left: -1.5, top: -40,
                transformOrigin: "50% 100%",
                transform: `rotate(${deg}deg) translateY(-6px)`,
                animation: `selectBeam 0.45s ${i*0.025+0.05}s ease-out forwards`,
                "--r": `${deg}deg`,
                borderRadius: 2,
                opacity: 0,
              }} />
            ))}

            {/* ── Sparks ── */}
            {sparks.map((s, i) => (
              <div key={i} style={{
                position: "absolute",
                width: s.size, height: s.size, borderRadius: "50%",
                background: s.col,
                boxShadow: `0 0 ${s.size*2}px ${s.col}`,
                marginLeft: -s.size/2, marginTop: -s.size/2,
                "--sx": s.sx, "--sy": s.sy,
                animation: `tapSpark 0.85s ${s.delay}s ease-out forwards`,
              }} />
            ))}

            {/* ── Floating kanji (大きく神々しく) ── */}
            <div style={{
              position: "absolute",
              fontSize: 32,
              fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif",
              fontWeight: 900,
              background: `linear-gradient(135deg, #fff5a0, ${color}, #ffffff)`,
              WebkitBackgroundClip: "text", WebkitTextFillColor: "transparent",
              backgroundClip: "text",
              filter: `drop-shadow(0 0 16px ${color}) drop-shadow(0 0 8px ${gold})`,
              marginLeft: -16, marginTop: -60,
              animation: "selectKanjiRise 1.0s ease-out forwards",
              opacity: 0,
              whiteSpace: "nowrap",
            }}>{kanji}</div>

          </div>
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
}
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// ── Final Light Effect (7th question answered) ───────────────
function FinalLightEffect() {
  const rays = Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, i) => i * 45);
  const rings = [80, 180, 320];

  return (
    <div style={{
      position: "fixed", inset: 0, zIndex: 150,
      display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center",
      pointerEvents: "none", overflow: "hidden",
    }}>
      {/* BG glow */}
      <div style={{
        position: "absolute", inset: 0,
        background: "radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%, rgba(129,216,208,0.18) 0%, rgba(255,215,0,0.08) 40%, transparent 70%)",
        animation: "finalGlow 2.0s ease forwards",
      }}/>

      {/* 3 rings */}
      {rings.map((r, i) => (
        <div key={i} style={{
          position: "absolute",
          width: r, height: r, borderRadius: "50%",
          border: `${2-i*0.5}px solid ${i%2===0?"rgba(129,216,208,0.85)":"rgba(255,215,0,0.75)"}`,
          animation: `introFlashRing 2.0s ${i*0.12}s ease-out forwards`,
          opacity: 0,
          boxShadow: i%2===0 ? "0 0 16px rgba(129,216,208,0.5)" : "0 0 14px rgba(255,215,0,0.4)",
        }}/>
      ))}

      {/* 8 rays */}
      {rays.map((deg, i) => (
        <div key={i} style={{
          position: "absolute",
          width: i%2===0 ? 2 : 1,
          height: i%2===0 ? 220 : 150,
          background: `linear-gradient(180deg, ${i%2===0?"#ffd700":"#81D8D0"} 0%, transparent 100%)`,
          transformOrigin: "50% 100%",
          top: "50%", left: "50%", marginLeft: -1,
          transform: `rotate(${deg}deg) translateY(-100%)`,
          animation: `finalRay 2.0s ${i*0.04}s ease-out forwards`,
          opacity: 0, borderRadius: 2,
        }}/>
      ))}

      {/* Center burst */}
      <div style={{
        position: "absolute", width: 100, height: 100, borderRadius: "50%",
        background: "radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.95) 0%, rgba(129,216,208,0.7) 40%, transparent 70%)",
        animation: "introFlashRing 1.2s ease-out forwards",
        boxShadow: "0 0 60px rgba(129,216,208,0.9), 0 0 120px rgba(255,215,0,0.4)",
      }}/>

      {/* 神降臨 text */}
      <div style={{
        position: "absolute", textAlign: "center",
        animation: "introKanji 2.0s ease forwards", opacity: 0, zIndex: 10,
      }}>
        <div style={{
          fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif", fontWeight: 900,
          fontSize: "clamp(32px, 9vw, 46px)", letterSpacing: 12,
          background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #81D8D0, #ffffff, #ffd700, #ffffff, #81D8D0)",
          WebkitBackgroundClip: "text", WebkitTextFillColor: "transparent", backgroundClip: "text",
          filter: "drop-shadow(0 0 20px rgba(129,216,208,0.9)) drop-shadow(0 0 40px rgba(255,215,0,0.6))",
        }}>神　降　臨</div>
        <div style={{
          width: 80, height: 1, margin: "10px auto",
          background: "linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #ffd700, #81D8D0, #ffd700, transparent)",
        }}/>
        <div style={{
          fontSize: 11, letterSpacing: 6, color: "rgba(200,220,255,0.6)",
          fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif",
        }}>御神託が降ります</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// ── Divine Intro Sequence ────────────────────────────────────
const KAMI_SLOT_NAMES = [
  "天照大御神","素戔嗚尊","月読命","大国主命","建御雷神",
  "天宇受売命","伊弉諾尊","伊弉冉尊","稲荷大神","綿津見神",
  "経津主神","事代主神","建御名方神","豊受比売神","瀬織津姫",
  "大山祇神","軻遇突智神","罔象女神","手力男神","天之常立神",
];

function DivineIntroSequence({ phase }) {
  const [breathDone, setBreathDone] = useState(false);
  const [slotIdx, setSlotIdx] = useState(0);
  const [slotSpeed, setSlotSpeed] = useState(60);
  const [slotDone, setSlotDone] = useState(false);
  const [showQuery, setShowQuery] = useState(false);
  const [queryIdx, setQueryIdx] = useState(0);
  const queryText = "汝、何を求める者か——";
  const intervalRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (phase !== "intro") return;
    // Phase 1: breath message shown for 2.2s
    const t1 = setTimeout(() => {
      setBreathDone(true);
      // Phase 2: slot spins (after 神 finishes drawing + glow = ~4.8s)
      let speed = 55;
      let idx = 0;
      const spin = () => {
        idx = (idx + 1) % KAMI_SLOT_NAMES.length;
        setSlotIdx(idx);
        speed = speed + 2.5; // gradually slow down
        if (speed < 380) {
          intervalRef.current = setTimeout(spin, speed);
        } else {
          setSlotDone(true);
          // Phase 3: ancient query
          setTimeout(() => {
            setShowQuery(true);
            // type out one char at a time
          }, 300);
        }
      };
      intervalRef.current = setTimeout(spin, speed);
    }, 5000);
    return () => { clearTimeout(t1); clearTimeout(intervalRef.current); };
  }, [phase]);

  // Typewriter for query text
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!showQuery) return;
    if (queryIdx >= queryText.length) return;
    const t = setTimeout(() => setQueryIdx(q => q + 1), 80);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [showQuery, queryIdx]);

  if (phase !== "intro") return null;

  return (
    <div style={{
      position: "fixed", inset: 0, zIndex: 180,
      display: "flex", flexDirection: "column",
      alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center",
      background: "radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 40%, rgba(8,4,20,0.97) 0%, rgba(2,2,6,0.99) 100%)",
      pointerEvents: "none", overflow: "hidden",
    }}>


            {/* Phase 1: 墨で「神」が書かれる */}
      {!breathDone && (
        <div style={{ textAlign: "center", position: "relative" }}>
          {/* Ink brush kanji SVG */}
          <div style={{ position: "relative", width: 240, height: 240, margin: "0 auto" }}>
            {/* Glow background */}
            <div style={{
              position: "absolute", inset: 0,
              background: "radial-gradient(circle, rgba(200,160,40,0.08) 0%, transparent 70%)",
              animation: "breathe 2.2s ease-in-out infinite",
            }}/>
            <div style={{
               width: 240, height: 240,
               display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center",
             }}>
               <div style={{
                 fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif",
                 fontWeight: 900,
                 fontSize: 160,
                 lineHeight: 1,
                 background: "linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #c8a030 50%, #8a6010 100%)",
                 WebkitBackgroundClip: "text",
                 WebkitTextFillColor: "transparent",
                 backgroundClip: "text",
                 filter: "drop-shadow(0 0 20px rgba(200,160,48,0.8)) drop-shadow(0 0 40px rgba(200,160,48,0.4))",
                 animation: "inkReveal 3s ease forwards",
                 opacity: 0,
               }}>神</div>
             </div>

            {/* 墨のしぶき粒子 */}
            {[0,1,2,3,4,5].map(i => (
              <div key={i} style={{
                position: "absolute",
                width: 4+i%3*2, height: 4+i%3*2,
                borderRadius: "50%",
                background: "#c8a030",
                left: `${20+i*12}%`, top: `${30+Math.sin(i)*30}%`,
                opacity: 0,
                animation: `inkSplatter 0.4s ${3.4+i*0.06}s ease-out forwards`,
              }}/>
            ))}
          </div>


        </div>
      )}

      {/* Phase 2: Slot machine */}
      {breathDone && !slotDone && (
        <div style={{ textAlign: "center" }}>
          <div style={{
            fontSize: 11, letterSpacing: 6, color: "#c8a030",
            marginBottom: 24, opacity: 0.7,
            fontFamily: "'Noto Serif JP', serif",
          }}>汝を待ち続けた神が、今、目覚める</div>

          {/* Slot frame */}
          <div style={{
            position: "relative",
            padding: "12px 48px",
            border: "1px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.3)",
            borderRadius: 4,
            background: "rgba(200,169,48,0.05)",
            boxShadow: "0 0 30px rgba(255,215,0,0.15), inset 0 0 30px rgba(255,215,0,0.04)",
            overflow: "hidden",
          }}>
            {/* Scan line */}
            <div style={{
              position: "absolute", inset: 0,
              background: "linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 40%, rgba(255,215,0,0.06) 50%, transparent 60%)",
              pointerEvents: "none",
            }}/>
            <div style={{
              fontSize: "clamp(22px,6vw,34px)",
              fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif",
              fontWeight: 900,
              letterSpacing: 6,
              background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #8a6520, #ffd700, #fff5a0, #ffd700)",
              WebkitBackgroundClip: "text", WebkitTextFillColor: "transparent",
              backgroundClip: "text",
              filter: "drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(255,215,0,0.8))",
              whiteSpace: "nowrap",
              animation: "letterGlow 0.1s ease-in-out infinite",
              minWidth: 180, textAlign: "center",
            }}>
              {KAMI_SLOT_NAMES[slotIdx]}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Slot lines decoration */}
          <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "center", gap: 6, marginTop: 16 }}>
            {[0,1,2].map(i => (
              <div key={i} style={{
                width: 4, height: 4, borderRadius: "50%",
                background: "#ffd700",
                opacity: 0.3 + i*0.25,
                animation: `breathe ${0.5+i*0.15}s ease-in-out infinite`,
                boxShadow: "0 0 6px rgba(255,215,0,0.6)",
              }}/>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Phase 3: Ancient query — typewriter */}
      {slotDone && (
        <div style={{ textAlign: "center", animation: "fadeIn 0.4s ease" }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 11, letterSpacing: 6, color: "#c8a030", marginBottom: 32, opacity: 0.6, fontFamily: "'Noto Serif JP', serif" }}>
            — 神より —
          </div>
          <div style={{
            fontSize: "clamp(18px,5vw,26px)",
            fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif",
            fontWeight: 900,
            letterSpacing: 8,
            background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #fff5a0, #ffd700, #ffffff, #ffd700)",
            WebkitBackgroundClip: "text", WebkitTextFillColor: "transparent",
            backgroundClip: "text",
            filter: "drop-shadow(0 0 20px rgba(255,215,0,0.9)) drop-shadow(0 0 40px rgba(129,216,208,0.5))",
            minHeight: "1.5em",
          }}>
            {queryText.slice(0, queryIdx)}
            {queryIdx < queryText.length && (
              <span style={{ opacity: 0.7, animation: "breathe 0.6s ease-in-out infinite" }}>|</span>
            )}
          </div>
          {/* Decorative line */}
          {queryIdx >= queryText.length && (
            <>
              <div style={{
                width: 80, height: 1, margin: "24px auto 0",
                background: "linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #ffd700, transparent)",
                animation: "fadeIn 0.5s ease",
              }}/>
              {/* Divine flash before transition */}
              <div style={{
                position: "fixed", inset: 0, zIndex: 190, pointerEvents: "none",
                background: "radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%, rgba(129,216,208,0.25) 0%, rgba(255,215,0,0.12) 40%, transparent 70%)",
                animation: "introToQuiz 1.8s 0.5s ease forwards",
              }}/>
              {/* Horizontal light sweep */}
              <div style={{
                position: "fixed", top: "50%", left: 0, right: 0,
                height: 2, zIndex: 191, pointerEvents: "none",
                background: "linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #81D8D0, #ffffff, #ffd700, #ffffff, #81D8D0, transparent)",
                boxShadow: "0 0 20px rgba(129,216,208,0.8), 0 0 40px rgba(255,215,0,0.4)",
                animation: "introToQuiz 1.5s 0.6s ease forwards",
              }}/>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── CutIn Component ─────────────────────────────────────────
function CutInScreen({ result, rarity }) {
  const typeColor = {
    "天津神": "#f0c060", "国津神": "#70d4a0",
    "黄泉神": "#b070d0", "常世神": "#60b0f0",
  };
  const rarityColor = { common: null, high: "#e8b830", rare: "#81D8D0", ultra: "#ff55ff" };
  const col = rarityColor[rarity] || typeColor[result?.kami_type] || "#81D8D0";
  const isUltra = rarity === "ultra";
  const isRare  = rarity === "rare" || isUltra;
  const dur = isUltra ? "4.2s" : isRare ? "3.4s" : "2.8s";

  return (
    <div style={{
      position: "fixed", inset: 0, zIndex: 200,
      display: "flex", flexDirection: "column",
      alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center",
      background: "#000",
      animation: `cutInBg ${dur} ease forwards`,
      pointerEvents: "none",
      overflow: "hidden",
    }}>
      {/* Scan lines */}
      <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, backgroundImage: "repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.015) 0px, rgba(255,255,255,0.015) 1px, transparent 1px, transparent 4px)" }} />

      {/* Ultra: shaking screen */}
      {isUltra && (
        <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, animation: "ultraShake 0.08s 1.2s 8 alternate ease-in-out", background: "transparent" }} />
      )}

      {/* Particle rain — rare & ultra only */}
      {isRare && Array.from({length: isUltra ? 15 : 8}).map((_,i) => (
        <div key={i} style={{
          position: "absolute",
          left: `${Math.random()*100}%`,
          top: `-${Math.random()*20}%`,
          width: isUltra ? 3 : 2,
          height: isUltra ? `${40+Math.random()*80}px` : `${20+Math.random()*50}px`,
          background: `linear-gradient(180deg, ${col}, transparent)`,
          opacity: 0.4 + Math.random()*0.5,
          animation: `particleFall ${0.8+Math.random()*1.4}s ${Math.random()*2}s ease-in forwards`,
          borderRadius: 2,
        }} />
      ))}

      {/* Flash */}
      <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, background: col, animation: `cutInFlash ${dur} ease forwards`, opacity: 0 }} />

      {/* Ultra: second flash in different color */}
      {isUltra && <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, background: "#ffffff", animation: "ultraFlash2 4.2s ease forwards", opacity: 0 }} />}

      {/* Torii */}
      <div style={{ position: "relative", marginBottom: isUltra ? 20 : 32, animation: `cutInTorii ${dur} ease forwards`,
        filter: isUltra ? `drop-shadow(0 0 40px ${col}) drop-shadow(0 0 80px ${col})` : `drop-shadow(0 0 20px ${col})` }}>
        <ToriiSVG size={isUltra ? 160 : 130} />
      </div>

      {/* Rarity badge — rare & ultra only */}
      {isRare && (
        <div style={{
          fontSize: isUltra ? 14 : 12, letterSpacing: 8,
          color: col, marginBottom: 12,
          textShadow: `0 0 20px ${col}, 0 0 40px ${col}`,
          animation: `cutInName ${dur} ease forwards`,
          fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif",
          fontWeight: 900,
        }}>
          {"✦".repeat(isUltra ? 4 : 3)} {isUltra ? "超激レア顕現" : "激レア顕現"} {"✦".repeat(isUltra ? 4 : 3)}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Deity name */}
      <div style={{ textAlign: "center", animation: `cutInName ${dur} ease forwards` }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 11, letterSpacing: 10, color: col, marginBottom: 12, opacity: 0.8 }}>— 守護神顕現 —</div>
        <div style={{
          fontSize: `clamp(${isUltra?"42px":"36px"}, 10vw, ${isUltra?"72px":"60px"})`,
          fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif",
          fontWeight: 900, letterSpacing: 8,
          background: isUltra
            ? `linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff, ${col}, #ffffff, ${col}, #ffffff)`
            : `linear-gradient(135deg, ${col}, #ffffff, ${col})`,
          WebkitBackgroundClip: "text", WebkitTextFillColor: "transparent", backgroundClip: "text",
          filter: `drop-shadow(0 0 ${isUltra?50:30}px ${col})`,
        }}>
          {result?.kami_name}
        </div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 14, color: col, letterSpacing: 6, marginTop: 10, opacity: 0.8 }}>{result?.kami_reading}</div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 16, letterSpacing: 4, marginTop: 10 }}>{result?.kami_symbol}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const RARITY_SUFFIX = {
  common: ", NEO anime style, tiffany blue and gold color palette, dark mystical background, glowing sacred aura, ultra detailed, 8k",
  high:   ", NEO anime style, tiffany blue and gold luminous palette, ethereal dark shrine background, radiant divine aura, elaborate ceremonial robes with gold embroidery, shimmering light particles, cinematic composition, ultra detailed, 8k",
  rare:   ", NEO anime style, tiffany blue neon and pure gold palette, dramatic dark celestial background, explosive sacred aura, intricate divine armor with glowing runes, cascading light beams from above, floating sacred symbols, dynamic cinematic angle, volumetric lighting, ultra detailed, 8k",
  ultra:  ", NEO anime style, transcendent tiffany blue and divine gold and ethereal white palette, cataclysmic dark cosmos background, overwhelming radiant aura that fills the frame, hyper-ornate divine regalia with luminous ancient inscriptions, torrents of golden light, petals of pure energy, shockwave of sacred power, gods descending behind, breathtaking legendary composition, volumetric god rays, ultra hyper detailed, 16k masterpiece",
};

// ── Copy Button ──────────────────────────────────────────────
function CopyButton({ text, color }) {
  const [state, setState] = useState("idle");

  const handleCopy = (e) => {
    // Synchronous execCommand approach — must be in direct click handler
    const ta = document.createElement("textarea");
    ta.value = text;
    ta.style.cssText = "position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:2em;height:2em;padding:0;border:none;outline:none;box-shadow:none;background:transparent;opacity:0;";
    document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.focus();
    ta.select();
    ta.setSelectionRange(0, ta.value.length);
    let ok = false;
    try { ok = document.execCommand("copy"); } catch (_) {}
    document.body.removeChild(ta);

    if (ok) {
      setState("success");
      setTimeout(() => setState("idle"), 2500);
    } else {
      // Last resort: navigator.clipboard
      navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text).then(() => {
        setState("success");
        setTimeout(() => setState("idle"), 2500);
      }).catch(() => {
        setState("error");
        setTimeout(() => setState("idle"), 2500);
      });
    }
  };

  return (
    <button
      onClick={handleCopy}
      style={{
        width: "100%", marginTop: 10,
        padding: "13px 0",
        background: state === "success"
          ? `linear-gradient(135deg, ${color}25, ${color}10)`
          : `linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.05), rgba(255,255,255,0.02))`,
        border: `1px solid ${state === "success" ? color : color + "45"}`,
        borderRadius: 4,
        color: state === "success" ? color : color + "bb",
        fontSize: 13, letterSpacing: 4,
        fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif",
        cursor: "pointer",
        transition: "all 0.3s ease",
        textShadow: state === "success" ? `0 0 12px ${color}` : "none",
        boxShadow: state === "success" ? `0 0 24px ${color}35` : "none",
        display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", gap: 10,
        animation: state === "success" ? "letterGlow 1.2s ease-in-out infinite" : "none",
      }}
    >
      <span style={{ fontSize: 16 }}>
        {state === "success" ? "✨" : state === "error" ? "⚠️" : "📋"}
      </span>
      {state === "success" ? "コピー完了！" : state === "error" ? "コピー失敗 — 再度お試しください" : "プロンプトをコピー"}
    </button>
  );
}

function ImagePromptCard({ prompt, kamiName, rarity }) {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(false);
  const taRef = useRef(null);

  const rarityColor = { common:"#81D8D0", high:"#e8b830", rare:"#81D8D0", ultra:"#ff55ff" }[rarity] || "#81D8D0";
  const rarityLabel = { common: null, high:"✦✦ 上位プロンプト", rare:"✦✦✦ 激レアプロンプト", ultra:"✦✦✦✦ 超激レアプロンプト" }[rarity];

  // Base prompt without the default suffix, then append rarity-specific suffix
  const baseSuffix = ", NEO anime style, tiffany blue and gold color palette, dark mystical background, glowing sacred aura, ultra detailed, 8k";
  const basePrompt = prompt.endsWith(baseSuffix)
    ? prompt.slice(0, -baseSuffix.length)
    : prompt.replace(/, NEO anime style.*$/i, "");
  const enhancedPrompt = basePrompt + (RARITY_SUFFIX[rarity] || RARITY_SUFFIX.common);

  const handleTap = () => {
    if (!taRef.current) return;
    taRef.current.select();
    taRef.current.setSelectionRange(0, 99999);
    setSelected(true);
  };

  return (
    <div style={{
      marginBottom: 24, borderRadius: 4,
      border: `1px solid ${rarityColor}40`,
      background: `${rarityColor}05`,
      boxShadow: rarity === "ultra" ? `0 0 20px ${rarityColor}20` : "none",
    }}>
      {/* Header */}
      <div style={{ padding: "12px 16px 8px" }}>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", marginBottom: 4 }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 9, letterSpacing: 5, color: rarityColor, opacity: 0.7 }}>🎨 キャラクター生成プロンプト</div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: rarityColor, opacity: 0.5 }}>{kamiName}</div>
        </div>
        {rarityLabel && (
          <div style={{
            fontSize: 11, letterSpacing: 3, color: rarityColor,
            textShadow: rarity === "ultra" ? `0 0 10px ${rarityColor}` : "none",
            animation: rarity !== "common" ? "rarityBadgePulse 2s infinite" : "none",
          }}>
            {rarityLabel} — 強化済み
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div style={{ padding: "0 14px 14px" }}>
        <textarea
          ref={taRef}
          readOnly
          value={enhancedPrompt}
          onClick={handleTap}
          onFocus={handleTap}
          rows={rarity === "ultra" ? 8 : rarity === "rare" ? 7 : 5}
          style={{
            width: "100%",
            background: selected ? `${rarityColor}10` : "rgba(0,0,0,0.3)",
            border: `1px solid ${selected ? rarityColor : rarityColor + "30"}`,
            borderRadius: 3,
            color: rarityColor,
            fontSize: 11, lineHeight: 1.8, padding: "12px",
            fontFamily: "monospace", resize: "none", outline: "none",
            cursor: "text", boxSizing: "border-box", transition: "all 0.2s",
            boxShadow: selected ? `0 0 14px ${rarityColor}20` : "none",
          }}
        />
        {/* Copy button */}
        <CopyButton text={enhancedPrompt} color={rarityColor} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function ButtonFlashEffect() {
  const vortexRings = Array.from({ length: 3 }, (_, i) => i);
  const beams = Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, i) => i * 45);
  const spiralDots = Array.from({ length: 32 }, (_, i) => {

// ── Ofuda Next Button ────────────────────────────────────────
function OfudaInkLayer() {
  return (
    <div style={{
      position: "absolute", inset: 0, pointerEvents: "none",
      display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center",
    }}>
      <div style={{
        fontSize: 52, color: "rgba(255,215,0,0.04)",
        fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif", userSelect: "none",
      }}>神</div>
      {[20,50,80].map(pct => (
        <div key={pct} style={{
          position: "absolute", top: 6, bottom: 6,
          left: `${pct}%`, width: 1,
          background: "linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, rgba(255,215,0,0.1), transparent)",
        }}/>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function OfudaNextButton({ label, onClick, style = {} }) {
  const [inkEffects, setInkEffects] = useState([]);

  const handleClick = (e) => {
    const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
    const id = Date.now();
    setInkEffects(prev => [...prev, { id, x, y }]);
    setTimeout(() => setInkEffects(prev => prev.filter(i => i.id !== id)), 900);
    onClick && onClick(e);
  };

  return (
    <button
      className="next-btn"
      onClick={handleClick}
      style={{ ...style, borderRadius: 4, position: "relative", overflow: "hidden" }}
    >
      <OfudaInkLayer />
      {inkEffects.map(({ id, x, y }) => (
        <div key={id} style={{
          position: "absolute",
          width: 100, height: 100, borderRadius: "50%",
          background: "radial-gradient(circle, rgba(20,10,0,0.65) 0%, rgba(40,20,0,0.35) 40%, transparent 70%)",
          left: x - 50, top: y - 50, pointerEvents: "none",
          animation: "inkSpread 0.85s ease-out forwards",
          mixBlendMode: "multiply",
        }}/>
      ))}
      <span style={{ position: "relative", zIndex: 2 }}>{label}</span>
    </button>
  );
}

// ── Ofuda Button Component ───────────────────────────────────
const OFUDA_BG_CHARS = ["神","縁","霊","命","天","光","魂","福","聖","潔"];

function OfudaButton({ opt, selected, compact, onSelect }) {
  const bgChar = OFUDA_BG_CHARS[opt.value.charCodeAt(0) % OFUDA_BG_CHARS.length];
  const handleClick = () => { onSelect(); };

  return (
    <button
      className={`option-btn ${selected ? "selected" : ""}`}
      onClick={handleClick}
      style={{
        padding: compact ? "12px 6px" : "18px 12px",
        borderRadius: 4, textAlign: "center",
        width: "100%",
      }}
    >
      {/* Ofuda background watermark */}
      <div style={{
        position: "absolute", inset: 0,
        display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center",
        fontSize: 48, color: "rgba(255,215,0,0.04)",
        fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif", fontWeight: 900,
        pointerEvents: "none", userSelect: "none",
        transition: "opacity 0.5s",
        opacity: selected ? 1 : 0.5,
      }}>{bgChar}</div>



      {/* Selected glow */}
      {selected && (
        <div style={{
          position: "absolute", inset: 0,
          background: "linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,240,160,0.12) 0%, transparent 50%, rgba(255,220,80,0.08) 100%)",
          pointerEvents: "none",
        }}/>
      )}

      {/* Element icon */}
      {ElementIcons[opt.value] && (
        <div style={{
          position: "relative", zIndex: 2, marginBottom: 6,
          filter: selected ? `drop-shadow(0 0 12px currentColor)` : "none",
          transition: "filter 0.3s",
          display: "flex", justifyContent: "center",
          transform: selected ? "scale(1.12)" : "scale(1)",
          transition: "transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)",
        }}>
          {ElementIcons[opt.value]()}
        </div>
      )}
      {/* Label */}
      <div style={{
        position: "relative", zIndex: 2,
        fontSize: compact ? 14 : 17,
        marginBottom: opt.sub ? 4 : 0,
        fontWeight: 600,
        fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif",
        transition: "all 0.3s",
        textShadow: selected ? "0 0 16px rgba(255,245,160,1), 0 0 32px rgba(255,215,0,0.7)" : "none",
      }}>{opt.label}</div>
      {opt.sub && (
        <div style={{
          position: "relative", zIndex: 2,
          fontSize: 10, opacity: selected ? 0.8 : 0.5,
          letterSpacing: 0.5, lineHeight: 1.4,
          transition: "opacity 0.3s",
        }}>{opt.sub}</div>
      )}
    </button>
  );
}
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// ── Shrine Path + Deity Silhouette ──────────────────────────
function ShrinePath({ stage, realKamiName }) {
  const [approachStep, setApproachStep] = useState(0); // 0-5 how close deity is
  const [showName, setShowName] = useState(false);

  // Deity gradually approaches
  useEffect(() => {
    const t1 = setTimeout(() => setApproachStep(1), 800);
    const t2 = setTimeout(() => setApproachStep(2), 2200);
    const t3 = setTimeout(() => setApproachStep(3), 3800);
    const t4 = setTimeout(() => setApproachStep(4), 5200);
    const t5 = setTimeout(() => setApproachStep(5), 6800);
    return () => [t1,t2,t3,t4,t5].forEach(clearTimeout);
  }, []);

  // Show name when real kami arrives and deity is close
  useEffect(() => {
    if (realKamiName && approachStep >= 3) setShowName(true);
  }, [realKamiName, approachStep]);

  // Silhouette size/opacity based on approach
  const silhouetteSize = 20 + approachStep * 14;
  const silhouetteOpacity = 0.06 + approachStep * 0.1;
  const silhouetteBlur = Math.max(0, 12 - approachStep * 2.5);
  const fogOpacity = Math.max(0.1, 0.7 - approachStep * 0.12);

  // Torii gates — 5 in perspective
  const toriis = [
    { scale: 0.18, y: 52, opacity: 0.15 },
    { scale: 0.28, y: 50, opacity: 0.2  },
    { scale: 0.42, y: 46, opacity: 0.3  },
    { scale: 0.62, y: 40, opacity: 0.45 },
    { scale: 0.85, y: 28, opacity: 0.65 },
  ];

  return (
    <div style={{
      position: "relative",
      width: "100%",
      height: 140,
      marginBottom: 16,
      overflow: "hidden",
      borderRadius: 4,
      background: "linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(2,4,10,0.95) 0%, rgba(4,8,16,0.9) 100%)",
    }}>
      {/* Ground line */}
      <div style={{
        position: "absolute", bottom: 0, left: 0, right: 0,
        height: 40,
        background: "linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, rgba(129,216,208,0.04))",
      }}/>

      {/* Path lines — perspective */}
      {[0,1,2].map(i => (
        <div key={i} style={{
          position: "absolute",
          bottom: 0,
          left: `${50 - i*2}%`,
          width: `${i * 4}%`,
          height: "100%",
          background: `linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(129,216,208,0.0) 0%, rgba(129,216,208,${0.04+i*0.03}) 100%)`,
          transform: `skewX(${i === 1 ? -3 : i === 2 ? 3 : 0}deg)`,
        }}/>
      ))}

      {/* Toriis — perspective row */}
      {toriis.map((t, i) => (
        <div key={i} style={{
          position: "absolute",
          left: "50%",
          top: `${t.y}%`,
          transform: `translate(-50%, 0) scale(${t.scale})`,
          opacity: t.opacity,
          transition: "opacity 1s ease",
        }}>
          <img
            src={TORII_IMG}
            width={180}
            height={158}
            alt=""
            style={{ filter: "drop-shadow(0 0 8px #81D8D0)" }}
          />
        </div>
      ))}

      {/* Fog layers */}
      <div style={{
        position: "absolute", inset: 0,
        background: `radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 60%, transparent 20%, rgba(4,8,20,${fogOpacity}) 100%)`,
        transition: "background 2s ease",
        pointerEvents: "none",
      }}/>
      <div style={{
        position: "absolute", bottom: 0, left: 0, right: 0, height: "35%",
        background: `linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, rgba(8,12,24,${fogOpacity * 0.8}))`,
        transition: "background 2s ease",
        pointerEvents: "none",
      }}/>

      {/* Deity silhouette */}

      {/* Deity name reveal */}

      {/* Stage 0: hint text */}
      {stage === 0 && (
        <div style={{
          position: "absolute", bottom: 14, left: 0, right: 0, textAlign: "center",
          fontSize: 10, color: "#2a4050", letterSpacing: 4,
          fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif",
        }}>参道の奥から何かが近づく...</div>
      )}


    </div>
  );
}

// ── Kami Whisper — 神の声と神話断片 ─────────────────────────
const KAMI_VOICES = {
  "天照大御神": { voice: "汝よ、光の中に我は宿る——", myths: ["高天原を治める太陽の神","岩戸に隠れ世界を暗闇に包んだ","三種の神器の始まり"] },
  "素戔嗚尊":  { voice: "汝よ、嵐と共に我は来た——", myths: ["ヤマタノオロチを斬り伏せた英雄","草薙剣を世にもたらした剣の神","海原を支配する荒ぶる魂"] },
  "月読命":    { voice: "汝よ、静寂の中で我を聴け——", myths: ["夜の世界を永遠に支配する月の神","食神を斬り昼夜を分けた孤高の神","謎に包まれた古代の記憶"] },
  "大国主命":  { voice: "汝よ、縁の糸は繋がっている——", myths: ["縁結びと医療の祖神","幾多の試練を乗り越えた不死の神","出雲の大地を創り上げた国造りの主"] },
  "建御雷神":  { voice: "汝よ、雷鳴の中に我はいる——", myths: ["鹿島神宮に祀られる最強の武神","国譲りを成し遂げた天津神の使者","剣と雷を司る戦の神"] },
  "伊弉諾尊":  { voice: "汝よ、生命の源が見えるか——", myths: ["黄泉の国から逃げ帰り禊をした神","日本の国土を産んだ創造の父神","三貴子の生みの親"] },
  "稲荷大神":  { voice: "汝よ、豊穣の扉が開く——", myths: ["全国に三万社を持つ最多の神","狐を使いとする農業と商売の守護","伏見稲荷大社の御祭神"] },
  "経津主神":  { voice: "汝よ、決断の時は今——", myths: ["香取神宮に祀られる武の神","布都御魂剣に宿る霊験あらたかな神","国譲りを共に成した二柱の一"] },
  "豊受比売神":{ voice: "汝よ、大地の恵みを受け取れ——", myths: ["伊勢の外宮に祀られる食物の神","五穀豊穣と衣食住を守護する","天照の食事を司る大いなる母"] },
  "瀬織津姫":  { voice: "汝よ、罪は水に流れていく——", myths:["大祓詞に現れる水の浄化の神","罪穢れを大海原に運ぶ女神","謎多き封印された古代の神"] },
};

const DEFAULT_MYTHS = [
  "太古の記憶が目覚める...",
  "神話の糸が絡み合う...",
  "運命の扉が今、開かれようとしている...",
  "天地の理が汝に語りかける...",
];

function KamiWhisper({ kamiName }) {
  const [voiceIdx, setVoiceIdx] = useState(0);
  const [mythIdx, setMythIdx] = useState(0);
  const [showMyth, setShowMyth] = useState(false);
  const [mythVisible, setMythVisible] = useState(false);

  const data = KAMI_VOICES[kamiName];
  const voice = data?.voice || "汝よ、我は今ここにいる——";
  const myths = data?.myths || DEFAULT_MYTHS;

  // Typewriter for voice
  const [voiceChars, setVoiceChars] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (voiceChars >= voice.length) return;
    const t = setTimeout(() => setVoiceChars(v => v + 1), 90);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [voiceChars, voice]);

  // After voice finishes, start myth cycling
  useEffect(() => {
    if (voiceChars < voice.length) return;
    const t1 = setTimeout(() => setShowMyth(true), 400);
    return () => clearTimeout(t1);
  }, [voiceChars, voice]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!showMyth) return;
    setMythVisible(true);
    const cycle = setInterval(() => {
      setMythVisible(false);
      setTimeout(() => {
        setMythIdx(i => (i + 1) % myths.length);
        setMythVisible(true);
      }, 600);
    }, 3000);
    return () => clearInterval(cycle);
  }, [showMyth]);

  return (
    <div style={{ marginTop: 12, borderTop: "1px solid rgba(129,216,208,0.12)", paddingTop: 12 }}>

      {/* 神の声 — タイプライター */}
      <div style={{
        fontSize: 12,
        fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif",
        letterSpacing: 3,
        color: "#c8f0e8",
        textShadow: "0 0 12px rgba(129,216,208,0.6)",
        marginBottom: 10,
        minHeight: "1.6em",
      }}>
        {voice.slice(0, voiceChars)}
        {voiceChars < voice.length && (
          <span style={{ animation: "breathe 0.5s ease-in-out infinite", opacity: 0.7 }}>|</span>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* 神話の断片 */}
      {showMyth && (
        <div style={{
          fontSize: 11,
          fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif",
          color: "#a08840",
          letterSpacing: 2,
          lineHeight: 1.7,
          padding: "8px 12px",
          background: "rgba(200,160,40,0.05)",
          border: "1px solid rgba(200,160,40,0.15)",
          borderRadius: 3,
          transition: "opacity 0.5s ease",
          opacity: mythVisible ? 1 : 0,
          minHeight: "2.5em",
        }}>
          {myths[mythIdx]}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Kami Slot Machine ────────────────────────────────────────
const SLOT_NAMES = [
  "天照大御神","素戔嗚尊","月読命","大国主命","建御雷神",
  "天宇受売命","伊弉諾尊","稲荷大神","綿津見神","経津主神",
  "事代主神","建御名方神","豊受比売神","瀬織津姫","大山祇神",
  "軻遇突智神","罔象女神","手力男神","天之常立神","国之常立神",
];

function KamiSlot({ stage, realKamiName, eliminated, onDone }) {
  const [slotIdx, setSlotIdx] = useState(0);
  const [speed, setSpeed] = useState(60);
  const [slotDone, setSlotDone] = useState(false);
  const intervalRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (stage < 1) return;
    // Start spinning
    let spd = 60;
    const spin = () => {
      setSlotIdx(i => (i + 1) % SLOT_NAMES.length);
      spd = spd + 3;
      if (spd < 420) {
        intervalRef.current = setTimeout(spin, spd);
      } else {
        setSlotDone(true);
        onDone && onDone();
      }
    };
    intervalRef.current = setTimeout(spin, spd);
    return () => clearTimeout(intervalRef.current);
  }, [stage]);

  // When real name arrives and both are eliminated, show it
  const displayName = (slotDone && realKamiName) ? realKamiName : SLOT_NAMES[slotIdx];
  const isRevealed = slotDone && realKamiName && eliminated.length >= 2;

  if (stage < 1) return null;

  return (
    <div style={{
      margin: "10px 0 14px",
      display: "flex", justifyContent: "center",
    }}>
      <div style={{
        position: "relative",
        padding: "10px 32px",
        borderRadius: 4,
        background: isRevealed
          ? "rgba(129,216,208,0.08)"
          : "rgba(200,169,48,0.05)",
        border: `1px solid ${isRevealed ? "rgba(129,216,208,0.5)" : "rgba(255,215,0,0.25)"}`,
        boxShadow: isRevealed
          ? "0 0 20px rgba(129,216,208,0.3), inset 0 0 16px rgba(129,216,208,0.06)"
          : "0 0 10px rgba(255,215,0,0.1)",
        transition: "all 0.6s ease",
        minWidth: 220, textAlign: "center",
        overflow: "hidden",
      }}>
        {/* Scan line */}
        <div style={{
          position: "absolute", inset: 0,
          background: "linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 35%, rgba(255,215,0,0.04) 50%, transparent 65%)",
          pointerEvents: "none",
        }}/>

        {/* Slot text */}
        <div style={{
          fontSize: isRevealed ? 22 : 16,
          fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif",
          fontWeight: 700,
          letterSpacing: isRevealed ? 5 : 4,
          color: isRevealed ? "#81D8D0" : "#c8a030",
          textShadow: isRevealed
            ? "0 0 16px rgba(129,216,208,0.9), 0 0 32px rgba(129,216,208,0.4)"
            : `0 0 ${slotDone ? 10 : 6}px rgba(255,215,0,${slotDone ? 0.7 : 0.4})`,
          transition: "all 0.5s ease",
          animation: !slotDone ? "letterGlow 0.1s ease-in-out infinite" : "none",
          whiteSpace: "nowrap",
        }}>
          {displayName}
        </div>

        {/* Scanning dots when spinning */}
        {!slotDone && (
          <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "center", gap: 5, marginTop: 6 }}>
            {[0,1,2].map(i => (
              <div key={i} style={{
                width: 4, height: 4, borderRadius: "50%",
                background: "#ffd700",
                opacity: 0.4 + i * 0.2,
                animation: `breathe ${0.4 + i*0.15}s ease-in-out infinite`,
                boxShadow: "0 0 4px rgba(255,215,0,0.6)",
              }}/>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Revealed label */}
        {isRevealed && (
          <div style={{
            fontSize: 9, color: "#81D8D060",
            letterSpacing: 5, marginTop: 5,
            animation: "letterGlow 2s ease-in-out infinite",
            fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif",
          }}>✦ 縁 の 神 ✦</div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// ── KamiSlotBig — 没頭型大スロット ──────────────────────────
function KamiSlotBig({ stage, realKamiName, eliminated, onDone }) {
  const [slotIdx, setSlotIdx] = useState(0);
  const [slotDone, setSlotDone] = useState(false);
  const [revealed, setRevealed] = useState(false);
  const intervalRef = useRef(null);

  const realNameRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (stage < 1) return;
    let spd = 40;
    let idx = 0;
    const spin = () => {
      idx = (idx + 1) % SLOT_NAMES.length;
      // When slowing down and realName is available, steer toward it
      if (spd > 200 && realNameRef.current) {
        const targetIdx = SLOT_NAMES.indexOf(realNameRef.current);
        if (targetIdx >= 0) {
          // Calculate shortest path
          const diff = (targetIdx - idx + SLOT_NAMES.length) % SLOT_NAMES.length;
          if (diff <= 2) {
            idx = targetIdx;
            setSlotIdx(idx);
            setSlotDone(true);
            setRevealed(true);
            onDone && onDone();
            return;
          }
        }
      }
      setSlotIdx(idx);
      spd = spd + 2.2;
      if (spd < 480) {
        intervalRef.current = setTimeout(spin, spd);
      } else {
        // Force land on realName if available
        if (realNameRef.current) {
          const ti = SLOT_NAMES.indexOf(realNameRef.current);
          if (ti >= 0) setSlotIdx(ti);
          setRevealed(true);
        }
        setSlotDone(true);
        onDone && onDone();
      }
    };
    intervalRef.current = setTimeout(spin, spd);
    return () => clearTimeout(intervalRef.current);
  }, [stage]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (realKamiName) realNameRef.current = realKamiName;
    if (slotDone && realKamiName) setRevealed(true);
  }, [realKamiName, slotDone]);

  const displayName = (revealed && realKamiName) ? realKamiName : SLOT_NAMES[slotIdx];

  if (stage < 1) return null;

  return (
    <div style={{
      position: "fixed", inset: 0, zIndex: 50,
      display: "flex", flexDirection: "column",
      alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center",
      background: "radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%, rgba(10,8,4,0.97) 0%, rgba(2,4,2,1) 100%)",
      pointerEvents: revealed ? "none" : "auto",
      opacity: revealed ? 0 : 1,
      transition: "opacity 0.5s ease",
    }}>
      {/* Top label */}
      <div style={{
        fontSize: 10, letterSpacing: 8, color: "rgba(200,160,48,0.4)",
        fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif", marginBottom: 40,
        animation: "breathe 3s ease-in-out infinite",
      }}>汝を待ち続けた神が、今、目覚める</div>

      {/* Main slot */}
      <div style={{
        position: "relative",
        width: "85vw", maxWidth: 380,
        padding: "32px 20px",
        background: revealed
          ? "rgba(129,216,208,0.04)"
          : "rgba(255,215,0,0.02)",
        border: `1px solid ${revealed ? "rgba(129,216,208,0.4)" : "rgba(255,215,0,0.2)"}`,
        borderRadius: 4,
        boxShadow: revealed
          ? "0 0 60px rgba(129,216,208,0.2), inset 0 0 40px rgba(129,216,208,0.04)"
          : "0 0 20px rgba(255,215,0,0.08)",
        transition: "all 0.8s ease",
        textAlign: "center",
        overflow: "hidden",
      }}>
        {/* Scan line */}
        {!revealed && (
          <div style={{
            position: "absolute", inset: 0,
            background: "linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 40%, rgba(255,215,0,0.03) 50%, transparent 60%)",
            pointerEvents: "none",
          }}/>
        )}

        {/* Deity name */}
        <div style={{
          fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif",
          fontWeight: 900,
          fontSize: revealed ? "clamp(32px,10vw,52px)" : "clamp(24px,7vw,38px)",
          letterSpacing: revealed ? 8 : 6,
          color: revealed ? "#81D8D0" : "#c8a030",
          textShadow: revealed
            ? "0 0 30px rgba(129,216,208,1), 0 0 60px rgba(129,216,208,0.6), 0 0 100px rgba(129,216,208,0.3)"
            : `0 0 ${slotDone ? 16 : 8}px rgba(255,215,0,${slotDone ? 0.8 : 0.4})`,
          transition: "all 0.6s ease",
          animation: revealed ? "goldPulse 3s ease-in-out infinite" : "none",
          lineHeight: 1.3,
        }}>{displayName}</div>

        {/* Dots when spinning */}
        {!slotDone && (
          <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "center", gap: 8, marginTop: 16 }}>
            {[0,1,2].map(i => (
              <div key={i} style={{
                width: 6, height: 6, borderRadius: "50%",
                background: "#ffd700", opacity: 0.3 + i*0.2,
                animation: `breathe ${0.4+i*0.15}s ease-in-out infinite`,
                boxShadow: "0 0 6px rgba(255,215,0,0.6)",
              }}/>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Revealed label */}
        {revealed && (
          <div style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
            <div style={{
              width: 80, height: 1, margin: "0 auto 12px",
              background: "linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #81D8D0, transparent)",
            }}/>
            <div style={{
              fontSize: 11, letterSpacing: 6, color: "rgba(129,216,208,0.6)",
              fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif",
              animation: "tiffanyPulse 2s ease-in-out infinite",
            }}>✦ 縁の神 顕現 ✦</div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Bottom whisper */}
      {revealed && <KamiWhisper kamiName={displayName} />}

      {/* Particles */}
      {revealed && (
        <div style={{ position: "fixed", inset: 0, pointerEvents: "none", zIndex: -1 }}>
          {[...Array(12)].map((_, i) => (
            <div key={i} style={{
              position: "absolute",
              width: 3, height: 3, borderRadius: "50%",
              background: i%2===0 ? "#81D8D0" : "#ffd700",
              top: `${10+Math.random()*80}%`,
              left: `${5+Math.random()*90}%`,
              opacity: 0.4 + Math.random()*0.4,
              animation: `breathe ${1.5+Math.random()*2}s ${Math.random()*2}s ease-in-out infinite`,
              boxShadow: `0 0 6px ${i%2===0?"#81D8D0":"#ffd700"}`,
            }}/>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
