// ── Loading Screen Component ─────────────────────────────────
const CANDIDATE_POOLS = [
  ["天照大御神","素戔嗚尊","大国主命","建御雷神","天宇受売命"],
  ["伊弉諾尊","月読命","経津主神","事代主神","綿津見神"],
  ["建御名方神","豊受比売神","大山祇神","軻遇突智神","稲荷大神"],
  ["瀬織津姫","闇御津羽神","罔象女神","久延毘古神","天之常立神"],
  ["国之常立神","天照大神","須佐之男命","大己貴命","少名毘古那神"],
];

const ANSWER_LABELS = {
  season: { spring:"春", summer:"夏", autumn:"秋", winter:"冬" },
  element: { fire:"炎", water:"水", wind:"wind", earth:"土", void:"虚空" },
  shadow: { pride:"驕慢", longing:"孤独", fear:"恐怖", rage:"憤怒", desire:"欲望" },
  desire: { love:"縁・愛", power:"力・勝利", wisdom:"知恵", peace:"平和", creation:"創造" },
  trial: { relation:"人間関係", mission:"使命と迷い", wealth:"財と仕事", health:"心身の疲弊", change:"大きな変化" },
  time: { dawn:"夜明け前", morning:"朝", afternoon:"昼下がり", dusk:"黄昏", midnight:"深夜" },
};

function LoadingScreen({ answers, pendingResultRef, onSlotDone, cutInDone }) {
  const [stage, setStage] = useState(0);
  const [candidates, setCandidates] = useState([]);
  const [eliminated, setEliminated] = useState([]);
  const [answerStep, setAnswerStep] = useState(0);
  const [loadingText, setLoadingText] = useState("魂の記録を読んでいます...");
  const [realKamiName, setRealKamiName] = useState(null);
  const [stageFlash, setStageFlash] = useState(false);

  const ANSWER_LABELS = {
    season: { spring:"春", summer:"夏", autumn:"秋", winter:"冬" },
    element: { fire:"炎", water:"水", wind:"風", earth:"土", void:"虚空", thunder:"雷" },
    shadow: { pride:"驕慢", longing:"孤独", fear:"恐怖", rage:"憤怒", desire:"欲望", void_s:"虚無" },
    desire: { love:"縁・愛", power:"力・勝利", wisdom:"知恵", peace:"平和", creation:"創造", liberation:"解放" },
    trial: { relation:"人間関係", mission:"使命と迷い", wealth:"財と仕事", health:"心身の疲弊", change:"大きな変化", loss:"喪失・別れ" },
    time: { dawn:"夜明け前", morning:"朝", afternoon:"昼下がり", dusk:"黄昏", midnight:"深夜", witching:"丑三つ時" },
  };

  const ANSWER_TEXTS = answers ? [
    answers.birth_month && `生まれ月  ${answers.birth_month}月`,
    answers.season && `共鳴する季節  ${ANSWER_LABELS.season[answers.season] || answers.season}`,
    answers.element && `魂の元素  ${ANSWER_LABELS.element[answers.element] || answers.element}`,
    answers.shadow && `内なる影  ${ANSWER_LABELS.shadow[answers.shadow] || answers.shadow}`,
    answers.desire && `魂の渇望  ${ANSWER_LABELS.desire[answers.desire] || answers.desire}`,
    answers.trial && `今の試練  ${ANSWER_LABELS.trial[answers.trial] || answers.trial}`,
    answers.time && `魂の輝く刻  ${ANSWER_LABELS.time[answers.time] || answers.time}`,
  ].filter(Boolean) : [];

  // Watch for API result continuously
  useEffect(() => {
    const watch = setInterval(() => {
      if (pendingResultRef?.current?.kami_name) {
        setRealKamiName(pendingResultRef.current.kami_name);
        clearInterval(watch);
      }
    }, 200);
    return () => clearInterval(watch);
  }, []);

  // Answer step reveal
  useEffect(() => {
    const timers = ANSWER_TEXTS.map((_, i) =>
      setTimeout(() => setAnswerStep(i + 1), 600 + i * 950)
    );
    // Transition to candidates
    const baseDelay = 600 + ANSWER_TEXTS.length * 950 + 600;
    const t2 = setTimeout(() => {
      setStageFlash(true);
      playDivineSound("full");
      setTimeout(() => {
        setStageFlash(false);
        setStage(1);
        const pool = CANDIDATE_POOLS[Math.floor(Math.random() * CANDIDATE_POOLS.length)];
        const shuffled = [...pool].sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5).slice(0, 3);
        setCandidates(shuffled);
        setLoadingText("縁のある神を絞り込んでいます...");
      }, 700);
    }, baseDelay);

    const t3 = setTimeout(() => {
      setEliminated([0]);
      setLoadingText("さらに深く読み取っています...");
    }, baseDelay + 2000);

    const t4 = setTimeout(() => {
      setEliminated([0, 1]);
      setLoadingText("神託が降りてきます...");
      setStage(2);
    }, baseDelay + 3800);

    return () => { [...timers, t2, t3, t4].forEach(clearTimeout); };
  }, []);

  // When real name arrives, inject it as candidate[2]
  useEffect(() => {
    if (realKamiName && stage >= 1) {
      setCandidates(prev => {
        const next = [...prev];
        next[2] = realKamiName;
        return next;
      });
    }
  }, [realKamiName, stage]);

  const winnerName = realKamiName || (candidates[2] || "");

  return (
    <div className="card" style={{ paddingTop: 0 }}>
      {/* Stage transition — same as screen transition */}
      {stageFlash && <ScreenTransitionEffect />}


      {/* Answer review */}
      {stage === 0 && (
        <div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
          <div className="divine-label" style={{ textAlign: "center", marginBottom: 12, fontSize: 9 }}>
            — あなたの魂の記録 —
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 6 }}>
            {ANSWER_TEXTS.map((text, i) => (
              <div key={i} style={{
                display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 12,
                padding: "7px 12px", borderRadius: 4,
                background: i < answerStep ? "rgba(200,169,48,0.06)" : "rgba(255,255,255,0.01)",
                border: `1px solid ${i < answerStep ? "rgba(255,215,0,0.25)" : "rgba(255,255,255,0.05)"}`,
                transition: "all 0.6s ease",
                opacity: i < answerStep ? 1 : 0.15,
                transform: i < answerStep ? "translateX(0)" : "translateX(-12px)",
                animation: i < answerStep ? `stageReveal 0.5s ease forwards` : "none",
              }}>
                <div style={{
                  width: 6, height: 6, borderRadius: "50%", flexShrink: 0,
                  background: i < answerStep ? "#ffd700" : "#2a2a2a",
                  boxShadow: i < answerStep ? "0 0 8px rgba(255,215,0,0.8)" : "none",
                  transition: "all 0.4s",
                }}/>
                <div style={{
                  fontSize: 13, color: i < answerStep ? "#f0d060" : "#3a3a3a",
                  fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif", letterSpacing: 2,
                  textShadow: i < answerStep ? "0 0 8px rgba(255,215,0,0.4)" : "none",
                  transition: "color 0.4s",
                }}>{text}</div>
                {i < answerStep && (
                  <div style={{ marginLeft: "auto", fontSize: 10, color: "#ffd70060" }}>✓</div>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── 参道ビジュアル + 神のシルエット ── */}
      <ShrinePath stage={stage} realKamiName={realKamiName} />

      {/* Candidates */}
      {stage >= 1 && !cutInDone && (
        <KamiSlotBig
          stage={stage}
          realKamiName={realKamiName}
          eliminated={eliminated}
          onDone={onSlotDone}
        />
      )}


      {/* Bottom loader */}
      <div style={{ textAlign: "center" }}>
        <div style={{ position: "relative", width: 60, height: 60, margin: "0 auto 20px" }}>
          <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, border: "1px solid rgba(200,169,48,0.3)", borderRadius: "50%", animation: "spin-slow 3s linear infinite" }}/>
          <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 6, border: "2px solid rgba(129,216,208,0.5)", borderTop: "2px solid #81D8D0", borderRadius: "50%", animation: "spin-slow 1.2s linear infinite" }}/>
          <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }}>
            <img src={TORII_IMG} width={32} height={28} style={{ filter: "drop-shadow(0 0 6px #81D8D0)", animation: "breathe 2s ease-in-out infinite" }} alt="torii"/>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="divine-tiffany" style={{ fontSize: 12, letterSpacing: 4 }}>{loadingText}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

      }}/>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Hanko Stamp — 御朱印演出 ─────────────────────────────────
function HankoStamp({ kamiName, kamiType }) {
  const [stamped, setStamped] = useState(false);
  const [showShock, setShowShock] = useState(false);

  // Auto stamp on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    const t1 = setTimeout(() => {
      setStamped(true);
      setShowShock(true);
      // Play stamp sound via Web Audio
      try {
        const ctx = getAudioCtx();
        const now = ctx.currentTime;
        // Thud impact
        const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, ctx.sampleRate * 0.15, ctx.sampleRate);
        const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
        for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++)
          d[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * Math.exp(-i / (ctx.sampleRate * 0.025));
        const ns = ctx.createBufferSource();
        ns.buffer = buf;
        const lp = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); lp.type = "lowpass"; lp.frequency.value = 200;
        const g = ctx.createGain(); g.gain.value = 0.7;
        ns.connect(lp); lp.connect(g); g.connect(ctx.destination);
        ns.start(now);
        // Stamp ring tone
        const o = ctx.createOscillator(); const e = ctx.createGain();
        o.type = "sine"; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(180, now);
        o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(80, now + 0.3);
        e.gain.setValueAtTime(0.35, now); e.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + 0.5);
        o.connect(e); e.connect(ctx.destination); o.start(now); o.stop(now + 0.5);
      } catch(err) {}
    }, 300);
    const t2 = setTimeout(() => setShowShock(false), 1000);
    return () => [t1, t2].forEach(clearTimeout);
  }, []);

  // Type color for outer ring
  const typeColor = {
    "天津神": "#c8a030", "国津神": "#60b870",
    "黄泉神": "#9060c0", "常世神": "#4090d0",
  }[kamiType] || "#c8a030";

  // Shorten name for stamp (max 4 chars)
  const stampName = kamiName ? kamiName.slice(0, 4) : "神";
  const subName   = kamiName && kamiName.length > 4 ? kamiName.slice(4) : "";

  return (
    <div style={{
      display: "flex", justifyContent: "center",
      marginBottom: 28, position: "relative",
      height: 140,
    }}>
      {/* Shockwave ring */}
      {showShock && (
        <>
          <div style={{
            position: "absolute", top: "50%", left: "50%",
            width: 110, height: 110,
            marginLeft: -55, marginTop: -55,
            borderRadius: "50%",
            border: "3px solid rgba(180,40,20,0.6)",
            animation: "hankoShockwave 0.6s ease-out forwards",
            pointerEvents: "none",
          }}/>
          <div style={{
            position: "absolute", top: "50%", left: "50%",
            width: 80, height: 80,
            marginLeft: -40, marginTop: -40,
            borderRadius: "50%",
            border: "2px solid rgba(200,60,30,0.5)",
            animation: "hankoShockwave 0.5s 0.08s ease-out forwards",
            pointerEvents: "none",
          }}/>
        </>
      )}

      {/* Stamp body */}
      <div style={{
        position: "relative",
        width: 110, height: 110,
        animation: stamped ? "hankoStamp 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.3,1) forwards" : "none",
        opacity: stamped ? 1 : 0,
      }}>
        {/* Outer circle */}
        <svg width="110" height="110" viewBox="0 0 110 110"
          xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
          style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, animation: stamped ? "hankoInk 0.6s ease forwards" : "none", opacity: 0 }}>
          <defs>
            <filter id="stampRough">
              <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.9" numOctaves="4" result="noise"/>
              <feDisplacementMap in="SourceGraphic" in2="noise" scale="2.5"/>
            </filter>
          </defs>
          {/* Outer ring */}
          <circle cx="55" cy="55" r="50" fill="none"
            stroke="rgba(170,35,20,0.9)" strokeWidth="5"
            filter="url(#stampRough)"/>
          {/* Inner ring */}
          <circle cx="55" cy="55" r="43" fill="none"
            stroke="rgba(170,35,20,0.7)" strokeWidth="2"
            filter="url(#stampRough)"/>
          {/* Top arc text — 御神託 */}
          <path id="topArc" d="M 18,55 A 37,37 0 0,1 92,55" fill="none"/>
          <text fontSize="10" fill="rgba(160,30,15,0.85)" fontFamily="'Yuji Syuku', serif" letterSpacing="4">
            <textPath href="#topArc" startOffset="10%">— 御 神 託 —</textPath>
          </text>
          {/* Bottom arc text — type */}
          <path id="btmArc" d="M 18,55 A 37,37 0 0,0 92,55" fill="none"/>
          <text fontSize="9" fill="rgba(160,30,15,0.8)" fontFamily="'Yuji Syuku', serif" letterSpacing="3">
            <textPath href="#btmArc" startOffset="12%">{kamiType || "天津神"}</textPath>
          </text>
          {/* Vertical left/right lines */}
          <line x1="12" y1="55" x2="20" y2="55" stroke="rgba(160,30,15,0.7)" strokeWidth="1.5"/>
          <line x1="90" y1="55" x2="98" y2="55" stroke="rgba(160,30,15,0.7)" strokeWidth="1.5"/>
        </svg>

        {/* Center name */}
        <div style={{
          position: "absolute", inset: 0,
          display: "flex", flexDirection: "column",
          alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center",
          animation: stamped ? "hankoInk 0.6s ease forwards" : "none",
          opacity: 0,
        }}>
          <div style={{
            fontSize: stampName.length <= 2 ? 28 : stampName.length <= 3 ? 22 : 18,
            fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif",
            fontWeight: 900,
            color: "rgba(160,30,15,0.9)",
            letterSpacing: 2,
            lineHeight: 1.2,
            textAlign: "center",
            filter: "url(#stampRough)",
          }}>{stampName}</div>
          {subName && (
            <div style={{
              fontSize: 11,
              fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif",
              color: "rgba(150,25,12,0.8)",
              letterSpacing: 2,
              marginTop: 2,
            }}>{subName}</div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

              fill="url(#mgGoldGrad)" stroke="rgba(255,215,0,0.6)" strokeWidth="1"/>
            <circle cx="20" cy="11" r="4" fill="#100800" stroke="rgba(255,215,0,0.5)" strokeWidth="1"/>

// ── API Key Input Component ──────────────────────────────────
function ApiKeyInput({ onSave }) {
  const [val, setVal] = useState("");
  const [err, setErr] = useState("");

  const handleSave = () => {
    const trimmed = val.trim();
    if (!trimmed.startsWith("AIza")) {
      setErr("キーは「AIza」で始まります。確認してください。");
      return;
    }
    onSave(trimmed);
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ width: "100%", maxWidth: 440 }}>
      <input
        type="text"
        value={val}
        onChange={e => { setVal(e.target.value); setErr(""); }}
        placeholder="AIzaSy...（ここに貼る）"
        style={{
          width: "100%", padding: "14px 16px",
          background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.04)",
          border: `1px solid ${err ? "#ff6060" : "rgba(255,215,0,0.35)"}`,
          borderRadius: 4, color: "#f0d060",
          fontSize: 14, fontFamily: "monospace",
          outline: "none", marginBottom: 8,
          boxSizing: "border-box",
        }}
      />
      {err && (
        <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#ff8060", marginBottom: 8, letterSpacing: 1 }}>{err}</div>
      )}
      <button
        onClick={handleSave}
        style={{
          width: "100%", padding: "14px",
          background: "linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,215,0,0.12), rgba(255,215,0,0.06))",
          border: "1px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.5)",
          borderRadius: 4, color: "#ffd700",
          fontSize: 14, letterSpacing: 4,
          fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif",
          cursor: "pointer",
          boxShadow: "0 0 16px rgba(255,215,0,0.15)",
        }}
      >
        設定して始める →
      </button>
      <div style={{ textAlign: "center", marginTop: 16, fontSize: 10,
        color: "#2a4040", letterSpacing: 2 }}>
        キーはこのデバイスにのみ保存されます
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function App() {
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState("intro"); // intro | quiz | loading | result
  const [apiKey, setApiKey] = useState(() => localStorage.getItem("gemini_api_key") || "");
  const [showApiSetup, setShowApiSetup] = useState(() => !localStorage.getItem("gemini_api_key"));
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
  const stepRef = useRef(0);
  const answersRef = useRef({});
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState({});
  const [result, setResult] = useState(null);
  const [loadingText, setLoadingText] = useState("神々の声を聴いています...");
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(null);
  const [bgmMuted, setBgmMuted] = useState(false);
  const [bgAura, setBgAura] = useState(null); // element aura color
  const [showCutIn, setShowCutIn] = useState(false);
  const [cutInDone, setCutInDone] = useState(false);
  const [rarity, setRarity] = useState("common");
  const pendingResultRef = useRef(null); // store result before cutin
  const [showFinalEffect, setShowFinalEffect] = useState(false);
  const [showIntroFlash, setShowIntroFlash] = useState(false);
  const [showButtonFlash, setShowButtonFlash] = useState(false);
  const [debugMsg, setDebugMsg] = useState("");
  const [screenTransition, setScreenTransition] = useState(false);
  const [slotTransition, setSlotTransition] = useState(false);
  const [tapEffects, setTapEffects] = useState([]);
  const loadingRef = useRef(null);
  const bgmRef = useRef(null);

  // BGM — Web Audio synth
  useEffect(() => {
    let stopFn = null;
    let started = false;
    const startBgm = () => {
      if (started) return;
      started = true;
      try {
        const ctx = getAudioCtx();
        if (ctx.state === "suspended") ctx.resume();
        const gainNode = ctx.createGain();
        gainNode.gain.value = 0.18;
        gainNode.connect(ctx.destination);
        bgmRef.current = gainNode;
        stopFn = playBGMSynth(gainNode, ctx);
      } catch(e) { console.warn("BGM error:", e); }
    };
    startBgm();
    window.addEventListener("pointerdown", startBgm, { once: true });
    return () => {
      if (stopFn) stopFn();
      window.removeEventListener("pointerdown", startBgm);
    };
  }, []);

  const toggleBgm = () => {
    if (!bgmRef.current) return;
    if (bgmMuted) {
      bgmRef.current.gain.setTargetAtTime(0.38, getAudioCtx().currentTime, 0.3);
      setBgmMuted(false);
    } else {
      bgmRef.current.gain.setTargetAtTime(0, getAudioCtx().currentTime, 0.3);
      setBgmMuted(true);
    }
  };

  const LOADING_TEXTS = [
    "神々の声を聴いています...",
    "古代の記録を紐解いています...",
    "あなたの魂の紋様を読んでいます...",
    "天津神の御前に参上しています...",
    "運命の糸を手繰り寄せています...",
    "神託が降りてきます...",
  ];

  useEffect(() => {
    if (phase === "loading") {
      let i = 0;
      loadingRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        i = (i + 1) % LOADING_TEXTS.length;
        setLoadingText(LOADING_TEXTS[i]);
      }, 1800);
      return () => clearInterval(loadingRef.current);
    }
  }, [phase]);

  const triggerTransition = (callback, delay = 180) => {
    setScreenTransition(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setScreenTransition(false);
      callback();
    }, delay + 700);
  };

  const handleSelect = (val) => {
    try { playDivineSound("full"); } catch(err) {}
    setStep(prev => {
      // Record this answer
      const qId = QUESTIONS[prev]?.id;
      setTimeout(() => {
        setAnswers(ans => {
          const updated = { ...ans, [qId]: val };
          // If last question, start loading
          if (prev >= QUESTIONS.length - 1) {
            setShowFinalEffect(true);
            setTimeout(() => {
              setShowFinalEffect(false);
              setPhase("loading");
              fetchOmen(updated, apiKey);
            }, 2200);
          }
          return updated;
        });
      }, 0);
      // Advance step or stay on last
      return prev < QUESTIONS.length - 1 ? prev + 1 : prev;
    });
  };

  const handleNext = async () => {
    if (!selected) return;
    const newAnswers = { ...answers, [QUESTIONS[step].id]: selected };
    setAnswers(newAnswers);
    setSelected(null);

    if (step < QUESTIONS.length - 1) {
      playDivineSound("medium");
      setStep(step + 1);
    } else {
      playDivineSound("full");
      setPhase("loading");
      await fetchOmen(newAnswers);
    }
  };

  const rollRarity = () => {
    const r = Math.random() * 100;
    if (r < 3)  return "ultra";
    if (r < 15) return "rare";
    if (r < 40) return "high";
    return "common";
  };

  const RARITY_META = {
    common: { label: null,       color: null,      cutInMs: 2800 },
    high:   { label: null,       color: "#e8b830", cutInMs: 2800 },
    rare:   { label: "激レア",   color: "#81D8D0", cutInMs: 3400 },
    ultra:  { label: "超激レア", color: "#ff55ff", cutInMs: 4200 },
  };

  const fetchOmen = async (ans, apiKey) => {
    // ── Deity roster by rarity ──
  const DEITY_ROSTER = {
    // 普通 60% — 知名度は低めだが由緒ある神々
    common: [
      "木花咲耶姫","玉依姫命","天児屋命","布刀玉命","手力男神",
      "罔象女神","久延毘古神","大山祇神","豊受比売神","少名毘古那神",
      "宇迦之御魂神","八衢比古神","闇御津羽神","天之常立神",
    ],
    // 上位 25% — 人気・知名度あり
    high: [
      "大国主命","月読命","建御名方神","事代主神","大物主神",
      "瀬織津姫","天宇受売命","経津主神","稲荷大神",
    ],
    // 激レア 12% — 超有名・人気キャラクター
    rare: [
      "素戔嗚尊","天照大御神","建御雷神","伊弉諾尊","国之常立神",
    ],
    // 超激レア 3% — 神話最高位・原初の神々
    ultra: [
      "伊弉冉尊","天御中主神","高御産巣日神","神産巣日神",
    ],
  };

  // Pick candidates based on rarity (pre-rolled)
  const rarityForDeity = (() => {
    const r = Math.random() * 100;
    if (r < 3)  return "ultra";
    if (r < 15) return "rare";
    if (r < 40) return "high";
    return "common";
  })();

  // Pick 6 candidates: weighted toward rarity tier
  const candidateList = [
    ...DEITY_ROSTER[rarityForDeity].sort(() => Math.random()-0.5).slice(0, 3),
    ...DEITY_ROSTER["common"].sort(() => Math.random()-0.5).slice(0, 3),
  ].sort(() => Math.random()-0.5);

  const prompt = `あなたは古代日本神話の最高位の神託師です。回答者の魂の記録を読み解き、守護神を顕現させ、深遠な神託を授けてください。

【魂の記録】
- 生まれ月: ${ans.birth_month}月
- 共鳴する季節: ${ans.season}
- 魂の元素: ${ans.element}
- 内なる影: ${ans.shadow}
- 魂の渇望: ${ans.desire}
- 現在の試練: ${ans.trial}
- 魂の輝く刻: ${ans.time}

【守護神の候補リスト】（この中から最も縁深い一柱を必ず選んでください）
${candidateList.join("・")}

上記リストの中から回答者の魂に最も共鳴する神様を一柱選び、以下のJSON形式のみで回答してください（コードブロック・説明文不要）:
{
  "kami_name": "【必須】守護神の名前（候補リストから選ぶこと）",
  "kami_reading": "読み方（ひらがな）",
  "kami_realm": "司る領域（3〜5項目）",
  "kami_type": "天津神 or 国津神 or 黄泉神 or 常世神",
  "kami_symbol": "神を象徴する絵文字（2〜3個）",
  "kami_myth": "この神様にまつわる神話の一節（50字程度）",
  "oracle_title": "神託のタイトル（6〜10文字）",
  "oracle_past": "過去の因果への神託（80字）",
  "oracle_present": "現在の試練への神託（100字）",
  "oracle_future": "未来の光明への神託（100字）",
  "shadow_reading": "内なる影の解読（60字）",
  "score_love": 1〜100の数値,
  "score_work": 1〜100の数値,
  "score_money": 1〜100の数値,
  "score_health": 1〜100の数値,
  "score_spirit": 1〜100の数値,
  "guardian_spirit": "【必須】守護霊獣の名前（例：白龍・黒狐・金烏など）",
  "guardian_spirit_emoji": "霊獣を表す絵文字",
  "lucky_color": "吉色",
  "lucky_direction": "吉方位",
  "lucky_number": 1〜99の数値,
  "lucky_time": "吉の時間帯",
  "lucky_item": "開運アイテム",
  "forbidden_action": "今月絶対に避けるべき行動（30字）",
  "power_word": "力の言霊（4〜8文字）",
  "rival_kami": "試練を与える神の名前",
  "ally_kami": "縁のある別の神の名前",
  "destiny_number": 1〜12の数値,
  "kami_message": "神様から直接語りかける前向きなメッセージ（60〜80字）",
  "image_prompt_en": "English image generation prompt for this deity (100 words). Always end with: NEO anime style, tiffany blue and gold color palette, dark mystical background, glowing sacred aura, ultra detailed, 8k"
}`;

    try {
      // Anthropic API (Claude artifact)
      const res = await fetch("https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          model: "claude-sonnet-4-20250514",
          max_tokens: 2500,
          messages: [{ role: "user", content: prompt }],
        }),
      });
      const d = await res.json();
      let text = d.content?.map(b => b.text || "").join("") || "";
      const clean = text.replace(/```json|```/g, "").trim();
      setDebugMsg("API応答取得: " + clean.slice(0, 60) + "...");
      const parsed = JSON.parse(clean);
      setDebugMsg("");
      const rolled = rollRarity();
      setRarity(rolled);
      pendingResultRef.current = parsed;
      setResult(parsed);
      setShowCutIn(true);
      setCutInDone(false);
      const ms = RARITY_META[rolled].cutInMs;
      setTimeout(() => {
        setShowCutIn(false);
        setCutInDone(true);
        setSlotTransition(false);
        setScreenTransition(false);
        setPhase("result");
        setTimeout(() => {
          playKamiSound(parsed.kami_name, rolled);
          if (rolled === "ultra") playUltraRareSound();
        }, 200);
      }, ms);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("API Error:", e?.message || e);
      setDebugMsg("エラー: " + (e?.message || String(e)));
      // Retry once
      try {
        const res2 = await fetch("https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            model: "claude-sonnet-4-20250514",
            max_tokens: 2500,
            messages: [{ role: "user", content: prompt }],
          }),
        });
        const d2 = await res2.json();
        const text2 = d2.content?.map(b => b.text || "").join("") || "";
        const clean2 = text2.replace(/```json|```/g, "").trim();
        const parsed2 = JSON.parse(clean2);
        setDebugMsg("");
        const rolled2 = rollRarity();
        setRarity(rolled2);
        setShowCutIn(true);
        setCutInDone(false);
        const ms2 = RARITY_META[rolled2].cutInMs;
        setTimeout(() => {
          setShowCutIn(false);
          setCutInDone(true);
          setPhase("result");
          setTimeout(() => {
            playKamiSound(parsed2.kami_name, rolled2);
            if (rolled2 === "ultra") playUltraRareSound();
          }, 200);
        }, ms2);
        pendingResultRef.current = parsed2;
        setResult(parsed2);
        return;
      } catch(e2) {}
      // Final fallback — go back to quiz with error message
      setPhase("quiz");
      setDebugMsg("");
      alert("神託の取得に失敗しました。もう一度お試しください。");
    }
  };

  const restart = () => {
    setDebugMsg("");
    setPhase("intro");
    setStep(0);
    setAnswers({});
    setResult(null);
    setSelected(null);
  };

  const typeColors = {

  const handleSaveKey = (key) => {
    localStorage.setItem("gemini_api_key", key);
    setApiKey(key);
    setShowApiSetup(false);
  };

  if (showApiSetup) return (

          2. Googleアカウントでログイン<br/>

        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Input */}
      <ApiKeyInput onSave={handleSaveKey} />
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <>
      <style>{`

          0%   { opacity: 0; transform: scale(1.04); }
          100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
        }
        @keyframes inkDraw {
          to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
        }
        @keyframes inkGlow {
          0%   { opacity: 0; }
          30%  { opacity: 1; stroke: #ffffff; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 20px #ffd700); }
          60%  { opacity: 0.8; stroke: #ffd700; }
          100% { opacity: 0; }
        }
        @keyframes inkSplatter {
          0%   { opacity: 0.8; transform: scale(0) translate(0,0); }
          60%  { opacity: 0.6; }
          100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(1) translate(var(--sx,8px), var(--sy,-12px)); }
        }
        @keyframes selectFlash {
          0%   { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.85); }
          20%  { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.03); }
          70%  { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
          100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(1.06); filter: blur(4px); }
        }
        @keyframes selectRipple {
          0%   { transform: scale(0.8); opacity: 0.9; }
          100% { transform: scale(2.4); opacity: 0; }
        }
        @keyframes selectKanjiRise {
          0%   { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(0) scale(0.6); filter: blur(6px); }
          30%  { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-28px) scale(1.15); filter: blur(0); }
          80%  { opacity: 0.8; transform: translateY(-52px) scale(1); }
          100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-70px) scale(0.9); filter: blur(3px); }
        }
        @keyframes selectBeam {
          0%   { transform: scaleY(0) rotate(var(--r)); opacity: 0.8; transform-origin: 50% 100%; }
          100% { transform: scaleY(1) rotate(var(--r)); opacity: 0; transform-origin: 50% 100%; }
        }
        @keyframes tapBurst {
          0%   { transform: scale(0);   opacity: 0.9; }
          60%  { transform: scale(1);   opacity: 0.5; }
          100% { transform: scale(1.4); opacity: 0; }
        }
        @keyframes tapRay {
          0%   { transform: translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(var(--deg)) scaleY(0); opacity: 0.9; transform-origin: 50% 0%; }
          50%  { opacity: 0.7; }
          100% { transform: translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(var(--deg)) scaleY(1); opacity: 0; transform-origin: 50% 0%; }
        }
        @keyframes tapSpark {
          0%   { transform: translate(0,0) scale(1); opacity: 1; }
          100% { transform: translate(var(--sx),var(--sy)) scale(0); opacity: 0; }
        }
        @keyframes tapKanji {
          0%   { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(0) scale(0.6); filter: blur(6px); }
          30%  { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-20px) scale(1.1); filter: blur(0); }
          100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-60px) scale(0.9); filter: blur(3px); }
        }
        @keyframes finalBurst {
          0%   { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.2); }
          20%  { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.05); }
          80%  { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
          100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(1.15); }
        }
        @keyframes finalRay {
          0%   { opacity: 0; transform: scaleY(0) rotate(var(--r)); }
          25%  { opacity: 0.9; transform: scaleY(1) rotate(var(--r)); }
          75%  { opacity: 0.6; transform: scaleY(1) rotate(var(--r)); }
          100% { opacity: 0; transform: scaleY(1.3) rotate(var(--r)); }
        }
        @keyframes finalPetal {
          0%   { opacity: 0; transform: translate(0,0) scale(0); }
          20%  { opacity: 1; transform: translate(var(--tx), var(--ty)) scale(1); }
          100% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(calc(var(--tx)*2.5), calc(var(--ty)*2.5 + 60px)) scale(0.3) rotate(360deg); }
        }
        @keyframes finalGlow {
          0%,100% { opacity: 0; }
          30%,70% { opacity: 1; }
        }
        @keyframes finalText {
          0%   { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.7) translateY(10px); filter: blur(8px); }
          40%  { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.05) translateY(0);   filter: blur(0); }
          80%  { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) translateY(0);      filter: blur(0); }
          100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(1.1) translateY(-8px); filter: blur(4px); }
        }
        @keyframes particleFall {
          from { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 0.8; }
          to   { transform: translateY(110vh); opacity: 0; }
        }
        @keyframes ultraShake {
          from { transform: translate(-4px, -2px) rotate(-0.5deg); }
          to   { transform: translate(4px, 2px)  rotate(0.5deg); }
        }
        @keyframes ultraFlash2 {
          0%,100% { opacity: 0; }
          70%,74% { opacity: 0.6; }
        }
        @keyframes rarityBadgePulse {
          0%,100% { opacity: 0.7; transform: scale(1); }
          50%     { opacity: 1;   transform: scale(1.04); }
        }
        @keyframes cutInTorii {
          0%   { transform: scaleX(1);   opacity: 1; }
          60%  { transform: scaleX(1);   opacity: 1; }
          80%  { transform: scaleX(0.05) scaleY(1.2); opacity: 0.8; filter: brightness(3); }
          100% { transform: scaleX(0);   opacity: 0; }
        }
        @keyframes cutInName {
          0%   { opacity: 0; transform: scale(2.5) translateY(-20px); filter: blur(20px); }
          30%  { opacity: 0; transform: scale(2.5) translateY(-20px); filter: blur(20px); }
          60%  { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.05) translateY(0);    filter: blur(0); }
          85%  { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1);                     filter: blur(0); }
          100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.8) translateY(10px);  filter: blur(8px); }
        }
        @keyframes cutInFlash {
          0%,100% { opacity: 0; }
          55%,65% { opacity: 1; }
        }
        @keyframes cutInBg {
          0%   { opacity: 0; }
          10%  { opacity: 1; }
          80%  { opacity: 1; }
          100% { opacity: 0; }
        }
        @keyframes revealText {
          from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(16px); filter: blur(4px); }
          to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0);    filter: blur(0); }
        }
        @keyframes auraShift {
          from { opacity: 0; }
          to   { opacity: 1; }
        }
        @keyframes torii-glow {
          0%, 100% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(0,210,210,0.6)); }
          50% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 28px rgba(0,240,230,1)); }
        }
        .gold-text {
          background: linear-gradient(135deg,
            #8a6520 0%,
            #c8962a 20%,
            #ffd700 45%,
            #fff5a0 55%,
            #ffd700 65%,
            #c8962a 80%,
            #8a6520 100%
          );
          background-size: 100% auto;
          -webkit-background-clip: text;
          -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
          background-clip: text;
          filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(255,210,50,0.6));
        }
        /* ── 御札ボタン ── */
        .option-btn {
          position: relative;
          background: rgba(20,15,5,0.85);
          border: 1px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.35);
          color: #d4a830;
          cursor: pointer;
          transition: all 0.2s ease;
          font-family: 'Yuji Syuku', serif;
          overflow: hidden;
          -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
          touch-action: manipulation;
        }
        .option-btn:active {
          background: rgba(255,215,0,0.12);
          color: #fff5a0;
          border-color: rgba(255,215,0,0.8);
          transform: scale(0.97);
        }
        .option-btn.selected {
          background: rgba(255,215,0,0.1);
          color: #fff5a0;
          border-color: rgba(255,215,0,0.9);
          box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255,215,0,0.3), inset 0 0 16px rgba(255,215,0,0.06);
        }
        .next-btn {
          position: relative;
          background: linear-gradient(180deg,
            rgba(255,248,220,0.08) 0%,
            rgba(240,220,140,0.05) 40%,
            rgba(200,160,60,0.08) 100%
          );
          border: none;
          color: #f5e070;
          cursor: pointer;
          font-family: 'Yuji Syuku', serif;
          transition: transform 0.25s ease, color 0.3s;
          overflow: hidden;
          animation: ofudaGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
        .next-btn::before {
          content: "";
          position: absolute;
          inset: 0;
          border-top: 2px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.8);
          border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.8);
          border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.4);
          border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.4);
          border-radius: inherit;
          pointer-events: none;
        }
        .next-btn::after {
          content: "神";
          position: absolute;
          top: 50%; left: 50%;
          transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
          font-size: 48px;
          color: rgba(255,215,0,0.04);
          font-family: 'Yuji Syuku', serif;
          pointer-events: none;
          user-select: none;
        }
        .next-btn:hover {
          transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.02);
          color: #fff8a0;
          box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(255,215,0,0.3), 0 0 60px rgba(255,215,0,0.1);
          animation: ofudaSelected 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
        .next-btn:hover::before {
          border-top-color: rgba(255,235,0,1);
          border-bottom-color: rgba(255,235,0,1);
          border-left-color: rgba(255,215,0,0.7);
          border-right-color: rgba(255,215,0,0.7);
        }
        .next-btn:active {
          transform: translateY(-1px) scale(0.99);
        }
        .next-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.2; cursor: default; animation: none; transform: none; }
        .torii { animation: torii-glow 2s ease-in-out infinite; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 4px; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: #111; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #c8a96e44; border-radius: 2px; }
      `}</style>

      <div style={{ height: phase === "result" ? "auto" : "100dvh", minHeight: phase === "result" ? "100dvh" : "unset", background: "#080808", position: "relative", fontFamily: "'Noto Serif JP', serif", overflow: phase === "result" ? "auto" : "hidden" }}>
        {/* Dynamic element aura */}
        {bgAura && ELEMENT_AURA[bgAura] && (
          <div style={{
            position: "fixed", inset: 0, zIndex: 1, pointerEvents: "none",
            background: `radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 40%, rgba(${ELEMENT_AURA[bgAura].color},0.12) 0%, transparent 65%)`,
            animation: "auraShift 0.8s ease forwards",
          }} />
        )}
        {/* Radial gradient overlay */}
        <div style={{ position: "fixed", inset: 0, background: "radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%, rgba(0,180,180,0.08) 0%, transparent 70%)", pointerEvents: "none", zIndex: 1 }} />
        <div style={{ position: "fixed", inset: 0, background: "radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 100%, rgba(30,20,60,0.3) 0%, transparent 60%)", pointerEvents: "none", zIndex: 1 }} />

        {/* Cut-in overlay */}
        {showButtonFlash && <ButtonFlashEffect />}
        {screenTransition && phase !== "result" && <ScreenTransitionEffect />}
        {slotTransition && phase === "loading" && <ScreenTransitionEffect />}
        {showIntroFlash && <DivineIntroSequence phase={showIntroFlash ? "intro" : "off"} />}
        {showFinalEffect && <FinalLightEffect />}
        <TapBurstEffect effects={tapEffects} />
        {showCutIn && result && <CutInScreen result={result} rarity={rarity} />}

        {/* BGM mute toggle */}
        <button

            color: bgmMuted ? "#4a4a3a" : "#81D8D0",
            fontSize: 18, cursor: "pointer",
            display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center",

            transition: "all 0.3s",
            boxShadow: bgmMuted ? "none" : "0 0 12px rgba(129,216,208,0.3)",
          }}
        >
          {bgmMuted ? "🔇" : "🎵"}
        </button>

        <div style={{ position: "relative", zIndex: 2, maxWidth: 680, margin: "0 auto", padding: phase === "result" ? "32px 20px" : "0 20px", minHeight: phase === "result" ? "auto" : "100dvh", display: phase === "result" ? "block" : "flex", flexDirection: "column", justifyContent: "center", overflow: phase === "result" ? "visible" : "hidden", boxSizing: "border-box" }}>

          {/* ─── INTRO ─── */}
          {phase === "intro" && (
            <div className="card" style={{ textAlign: "center", width: "100%" }}>
              <div className="torii" style={{ marginBottom: 24, display: "inline-block" }}>
                <ToriiSVG size={120} />
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 11, letterSpacing: 6, color: "#81D8D0", marginBottom: 10, textAlign: "center",
                textShadow: "0 0 10px rgba(129,216,208,0.6)", animation: "tiffanyPulse 3s ease-in-out infinite",
                fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif" }}>

              </div>
              <div style={{ width: 40, height: 1, background: "linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #81D8D060, transparent)", margin: "0 auto 14px" }}/>
              <h1 className="gold-text divine-title" style={{ fontSize: "clamp(36px, 9vw, 60px)", fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif", fontWeight: 900, letterSpacing: 10, textAlign: "center", marginBottom: 4 }}>
                神託降臨
              </h1>
              <div style={{ width: 80, height: 1, background: "linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #c8a96e, transparent)", margin: "10px auto" }} />
              <p style={{ color: "#c8a040", fontSize: 16, lineHeight: 2.2, maxWidth: 380, margin: "0 auto 18px",

              {/* Decorative circles */}
              <div style={{ position: "relative", width: 120, height: 120, margin: "0 auto 20px" }}>

                <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 16, border: "1px solid rgba(200,169,110,0.1)", borderRadius: "50%", animation: "spin-slow 15s linear infinite reverse" }} />
                <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 32, border: "1px solid rgba(200,169,110,0.2)", borderRadius: "50%", animation: "breathe 4s ease-in-out infinite" }} />

                      playDivineSound("full");

                      setTimeout(() => {
                        setScreenTransition(false);
                        setPhase("quiz");
                      }, 900);
                    }, 9500);
                  }, 600); }}
                className="next-btn"

              >

              </button>

            </div>

          {/* ─── QUIZ ─── */}
          {phase === "quiz" && (

                      : i===step

                    boxShadow: i===step?"0 0 14px rgba(129,216,208,0.9)":i<step?"0 0 8px rgba(255,215,0,0.6)":"none",
                    transition:"all 0.4s",

                    key={opt.value}

              </div>
            </div>

                }}
              />
            </div>
          )}

          {phase === "result" && result && (
            <div className="card" style={{ animation: "revealIn 0.5s ease forwards" }}>

                  }}>
                    {"✦".repeat(rarity === "ultra" ? 4 : 3)} {rarity === "ultra" ? "超激レア" : "激レア"} {"✦".repeat(rarity === "ultra" ? 4 : 3)}
                  </div>

              </div>

              {/* ── 神話の一節 ── */}
              {result.kami_myth && (
                <div className="divine-frame" style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: "14px 20px", marginBottom: 24, borderRadius: 4 }}>
                  <div className="divine-label" style={{ fontSize: 9, marginBottom: 8 }}>神 話</div>
                  <p style={{ color: "#8a7050", fontSize: 13, lineHeight: 2, fontStyle: "italic", letterSpacing: 1 }}>「{result.kami_myth}」</p>

              <div style={{ textAlign: "center", marginBottom: 24 }}>

                </h3>
              </div>

                            {/* ── 三段神託（縦書き） ── */}
              {[
                { label: "過去の因果", icon: "🌑", text: result.oracle_past,    color: "#8080c0", delay: "0.1s" },
                { label: "現在の試練", icon: "⚡", text: result.oracle_present, color: "#81D8D0", delay: "0.4s" },
                { label: "未来の光明", icon: "🌕", text: result.oracle_future,  color: "#e8b830", delay: "0.7s" },
              ].map((o) => o.text && (
                <div key={o.label} style={{
                  marginBottom: 16,

                  border: `1px solid ${o.color}28`,

                  background: `${o.color}06`,

                  overflow: "hidden",
                }}>
                  {/* Header */}
                  <div style={{
                    padding: "10px 16px 8px",
                    borderBottom: `1px solid ${o.color}18`,
                    display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 8,
                  }}>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 14 }}>{o.icon}</span>
                    <span style={{
                      fontSize: 10, letterSpacing: 5, color: o.color,
                      fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif",
                      textShadow: `0 0 8px ${o.color}80`,
                    }}>{o.label}</span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Horizontal text body */}
                  <div style={{ padding: "14px 18px" }}>
                    <p style={{
                      color: "#e8c860",
                      fontSize: 14,
                      lineHeight: 2.2,
                      letterSpacing: 1,
                      fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif",
                      textShadow: "0 0 6px rgba(232,200,96,0.4)",
                      margin: 0,
                    }}>{o.text}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}

              {/* ── 影の解読 ── */}
              {result.shadow_reading && (
                <div style={{ marginBottom: 24, padding: "16px 20px", border: "1px solid rgba(160,80,160,0.25)", borderLeft: "3px solid #a050a0", borderRadius: 4, background: "rgba(100,40,100,0.06)" }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 10, letterSpacing: 4, color: "#a060b0", marginBottom: 8 }}>🌑 影の解読</div>
                  <p style={{ color: "#d090e0", fontSize: 13, lineHeight: 2, letterSpacing: 0.5, textShadow: "0 0 10px rgba(180,80,220,0.7)" }}>{result.shadow_reading}</p>
                </div>
              )}

              <div style={{ width: "100%", height: 1, background: "linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #81D8D022, #81D8D044, #81D8D022, transparent)", marginBottom: 24 }} />

                            {/* ── 五運スコア（勾玉） ── */}
              <div className="divine-frame-tiffany" style={{ marginBottom: 28, padding: "22px 18px", borderRadius: 4, position: "relative" }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 10, letterSpacing: 5, color: "#4a5a5a", marginBottom: 20, textAlign: "center" }}>— 五行運勢 —</div>
                {(() => {
                  const bonus = { common: 0, high: 8, rare: 18, ultra: 30 }[rarity] || 0;
                  const rarityGlow = { common: null, high: "#e8b830", rare: "#81D8D0", ultra: "#ff55ff" }[rarity];
                  const scores = [
                    { label: "縁・愛",   key: "score_love",   color: "#e07090", kanji: "縁" },
                    { label: "仕事・使命", key: "score_work",  color: "#81D8D0", kanji: "命" },
                    { label: "財・豊穣", key: "score_money",  color: "#e8b830", kanji: "財" },
                    { label: "心身",     key: "score_health", color: "#70c080", kanji: "健" },
                    { label: "霊・魂",  key: "score_spirit",  color: "#9080d0", kanji: "霊" },
                  ];
                  return scores.map(({ label, key, color, kanji }) => {
                    const raw = result[key] || 0;
                    const val = Math.min(100, raw + bonus);
                    const filled = Math.round(val / 20); // 0–5 magatama
                    const col = rarityGlow || color;
                    return (
                      <div key={key} style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
                        {/* Label row */}
                        <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", marginBottom: 8 }}>
                          <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 8 }}>
                            <div style={{
                              width: 22, height: 22, borderRadius: "50%",
                              background: `radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, ${col}aa, ${col}44)`,
                              border: `1px solid ${col}60`,
                              display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center",
                              fontSize: 9, color: col, fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif",
                              boxShadow: `0 0 8px ${col}40`,
                            }}>{kanji}</div>
                            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#9a8050", letterSpacing: 1 }}>{label}</div>
                          </div>
                          <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: col, fontWeight: 700,
                            textShadow: `0 0 8px ${col}80` }}>{val}</div>
                        </div>
                        {/* Magatama row — 5 gems */}
                        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, justifyContent: "center" }}>
                          {Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, mi) => {
                            const active = mi < filled;
                            const isRarityBoost = active && mi >= Math.round(raw / 20);
                            return (
                              <div key={mi} style={{
                                position: "relative",
                                width: 32, height: 40,
                                animation: active ? `revealText 0.4s ${mi * 0.12}s ease both` : "none",
                              }}>
                                <svg viewBox="0 0 32 40" width="32" height="40" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                  <defs>
                                    <radialGradient id={`mg${key}${mi}`} cx="35%" cy="30%" r="65%">
                                      <stop offset="0%" stopColor={active ? "#ffffff" : "#1a1a1a"} stopOpacity={active ? "0.9" : "0.5"}/>
                                      <stop offset="40%" stopColor={active ? col : "#2a2a2a"} stopOpacity="1"/>
                                      <stop offset="100%" stopColor={active ? col+"88" : "#111"} stopOpacity="1"/>
                                    </radialGradient>
                                    <filter id={`mgf${key}${mi}`}>
                                      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation={active ? "1.5" : "0.5"} result="b"/>
                                      <feMerge><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
                                    </filter>
                                  </defs>
                                  {/* Magatama body — teardrop/comma shape */}
                                  <path
                                    d="M 16,4 C 22,4 28,10 28,18 C 28,28 22,36 16,36 C 10,36 4,28 4,18 C 4,10 10,4 16,4 Z M 16,4 C 10,4 6,8 6,13 C 6,18 10,22 16,22 C 22,22 26,18 26,13 C 26,8 22,4 16,4"
                                    fill={`url(#mg${key}${mi})`}
                                    filter={`url(#mgf${key}${mi})`}
                                    stroke={active ? col : "#333"}
                                    strokeWidth="1"
                                    opacity={active ? 1 : 0.3}
                                  />
                                  {/* Hole */}
                                  <circle cx="16" cy="13" r="4"
                                    fill={active ? "#000000cc" : "#111"}
                                    stroke={active ? col+"80" : "#222"}
                                    strokeWidth="1"
                                  />
                                  {/* Highlight */}
                                  {active && (
                                    <ellipse cx="12" cy="8" rx="3" ry="2"
                                      fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.35"
                                      transform="rotate(-20 12 8)"
                                    />
                                  )}
                                  {/* Rarity boost shimmer */}
                                  {isRarityBoost && (
                                    <path
                                      d="M 16,4 C 22,4 28,10 28,18 C 28,28 22,36 16,36 C 10,36 4,28 4,18 C 4,10 10,4 16,4 Z"
                                      fill="none"
                                      stroke={rarityGlow || col}
                                      strokeWidth="2"
                                      opacity="0.7"
                                      style={{ animation: "rarityBadgePulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite" }}
                                    />
                                  )}
                                </svg>
                              </div>
                            );
                          })}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  });
                })()}
                {/* Rarity bonus label */}
                {rarity !== "common" && (
                  <div style={{ textAlign: "right", marginTop: 8, fontSize: 10, letterSpacing: 2,
                    color: { high: "#e8b830", rare: "#81D8D0", ultra: "#ff55ff" }[rarity], opacity: 0.7 }}>
                    { {high: "✦ 上位補正 +8", rare: "✦✦✦ 激レア補正 +18", ultra: "✦✦✦✦ 超激レア補正 +30"}[rarity] }
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* ── 守護霊獣 ── */}
              {result.guardian_spirit && (
                <GuardianSection spirit={result.guardian_spirit} rarity={rarity} />
              )}

              {/* ── 神々の関係 ── */}
              {(result.ally_kami || result.rival_kami) && (
                <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: 10, marginBottom: 24 }}>
                  {result.ally_kami && (
                    <div style={{ padding: "14px 12px", border: "1px solid rgba(100,200,100,0.2)", borderRadius: 4, background: "rgba(60,120,60,0.05)", textAlign: "center" }}>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: 9, letterSpacing: 3, color: "#4a8050", marginBottom: 6 }}>✦ 縁のある神</div>
                      <div style={{ color: "#80c080", fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 700 }}>{result.ally_kami}</div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {result.rival_kami && (
                    <div style={{ padding: "14px 12px", border: "1px solid rgba(200,100,100,0.2)", borderRadius: 4, background: "rgba(120,60,60,0.05)", textAlign: "center" }}>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: 9, letterSpacing: 3, color: "#804040", marginBottom: 6 }}>⚔ 試練を与える神</div>
                      <div style={{ color: "#c08080", fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 700 }}>{result.rival_kami}</div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}

              {/* ── 開運情報 ── */}
              <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: 10, marginBottom: 20 }}>
                {[
                  { label: "吉色", value: result.lucky_color },
                  { label: "吉方位", value: result.lucky_direction },
                  { label: "吉数", value: result.lucky_number },
                  { label: "吉の刻", value: result.lucky_time },
                ].filter(i => i.value).map((item) => (
                  <div key={item.label} className="divine-frame" style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: "14px 8px", borderRadius: 4 }}>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 9, letterSpacing: 3, color: "#5a4a2a", marginBottom: 6 }}>{item.label}</div>
                    <div style={{ color: "#ffd040", fontSize: 16, fontWeight: 700 }}>{item.value}</div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              {result.lucky_item && (
                <div className="divine-frame" style={{ textAlign: "center", marginBottom: 20, padding: "12px", borderRadius: 4 }}>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: 10, letterSpacing: 3, color: "#5a4a2a" }}>開運アイテム　</span>
                  <span style={{ color: "#e8b830", fontSize: 14 }}>✦ {result.lucky_item} ✦</span>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* ── 封印行動 ── */}
              {result.forbidden_action && (
                <div className="divine-frame-tiffany" style={{ padding: "14px 18px", borderLeft: "3px solid #81D8D0", borderRadius: 4, background: "rgba(0,100,100,0.04)", marginBottom: 20, position: "relative" }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 9, letterSpacing: 4, color: "#2a8080", marginBottom: 6 }}>🚫 封印すべき行動</div>
                  <p style={{ color: "#70a0a0", fontSize: 13, lineHeight: 1.8 }}>{result.forbidden_action}</p>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* ── 神様からのメッセージ ── */}
              {result.kami_message && (
                <div className="divine-frame" style={{
                  marginBottom: 24,
                  padding: "24px 22px",
                  borderRadius: 4,
                  background: "rgba(200,169,110,0.04)",
                  position: "relative",
                  animation: "revealText 0.7s 1.3s ease both",
                }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 9, letterSpacing: 5, color: "#4a3a2a", marginBottom: 16, textAlign: "center" }}>— 神様からの言葉 —</div>
                  {/* Opening quote mark */}
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 48, color: "#c8a96e22", fontFamily: "serif", lineHeight: 0.5, marginBottom: 8, userSelect: "none" }}>❝</div>
                  <p style={{
                    color: "#ffd84a",
                    fontSize: 16,
                    lineHeight: 2.2,
                    letterSpacing: 1.2,
                    fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif",
                    fontWeight: 400,
                    textAlign: "center",
                    padding: "0 8px",
                  }}>
                    {result.kami_message}
                  </p>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 48, color: "#c8a96e22", fontFamily: "serif", lineHeight: 0.5, marginTop: 8, textAlign: "right", userSelect: "none" }}>❞</div>
                  <div style={{ textAlign: "right", marginTop: 12, fontSize: 12, color: "#8a7050", letterSpacing: 3 }}>
                    — {result.kami_name}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* ── 力の言霊 ── */}
              <div className="divine-frame" style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: "24px 0", marginBottom: 24, borderRadius: 4 }}>
                <div className="divine-label" style={{ fontSize: 9, marginBottom: 14 }}>— 力の言霊 —</div>
                <div className="gold-text" style={{ fontSize: "clamp(26px, 8vw, 40px)", fontFamily: "'Yuji Syuku', serif", fontWeight: 900, letterSpacing: 14, animation: "goldPulse 2s ease-in-out infinite" }}>
                  {result.power_word}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* ── 画像生成プロンプト ── */}
              {result.image_prompt_en && (
                <ImagePromptCard prompt={result.image_prompt_en} kamiName={result.kami_name} rarity={rarity} />
              )}

              {/* ── Restart ── */}
              <div style={{ textAlign: "center" }}>
                <div style={{ width: 80, height: 1, background: "linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #c8a96e, transparent)", margin: "0 auto 24px" }} />
                <OfudaNextButton label="もう一度占う" style={{ padding: "16px 44px", fontSize: 15, letterSpacing: 4 }} onClick={() => { playDivineSound("full"); restart(); }} />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}


    ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(<App/>);
  </script>
</body>
</html>
